title: VP Business Strategy & Analytics
description:
At Exeter Finance, we are committed to helping customers find the right financing for their next vehicle purchase. By building strong relationships with our customers and network of dealer partners we are able to give options that make sense, getting customers behind the wheel of their car.

Every team member is integral to our success. Whether you’re at a servicing center helping customers with their loans, in the field building relationships with dealers, or supporting the company from its corporate offices, you'll enjoy a nurturing, invigorating and positive work environment.

Our vision is to be a premier finance company and lender of choice known for its People, Performance and Service.

Job Description

Summary
The Vice President, Business Strategy & Analytics leads the development and execution of analytics driven strategies that support profitable growth, credit performance, and risk management objectives. This role serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, providing recommendations related to credit policy, pricing, fraud mitigation, and origination strategies. The VP partners across business, technology, data, and modeling teams to develop and implement analytics driven initiatives that support originations performance and business objectives. Leading a team of analytics professionals, this role translates complex data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations that support informed decision-making and drive business results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead analytics and strategy initiatives focused on originations performance, credit quality, profitability, and risk management.
  • Analyze origination performance, market trends, competitor activity, and credit performance to identify opportunities and risks and recommend strategic actions.
  • Develop recommendations related to credit policy, pricing, fraud mitigation, and stipulation strategies based on analysis of origination performance, business results, and market conditions.
  • Provide data driven recommendations to senior leadership regarding credit, pricing, fraud, and origination strategies.
  • Collaborate with modeling and data science teams to evaluate, interpret, and provide business context for predictive models and analytical tools.
  • Lead cross-functional implementation of strategy changes by partnering with Information Technology, Operations, and business stakeholders.
  • Oversee business reporting, performance analytics, and management insights to support effective decision making and strategic planning.
  • Monitor strategy outcomes and recommend adjustments based on performance results and changing market conditions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop managers and analytics teams while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, business strategy, credit risk, originations, financial services, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of progressive leadership experience managing analytics, strategy, or business intelligence teams.
  • Demonstrated success influencing business decisions through data driven insights and leading cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, and strategic thinking skills with the ability to lead complex analytical initiatives and develop high-performing teams.
  • Knowledge of credit risk, pricing strategy, originations analytics, and predictive modeling concepts, including the ability to interpret model outputs and translate results into business recommendations.
  • Experience with business intelligence and data analysis tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate including

skill set, experience, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

title: Human Geographer

They will leverage their knowledge and experience with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and related geospatial production techniques, socio-cultural and regional analysis, remote sensing, and digital data formats to extract relevant information and develop geospatial intelligence reports and products to support the customer.


Primary Duties to include:

  • Utilize an understanding of geography, research, GIS, and data conflation and management skills to produce a broad array of human geography products including attributed data, maps, including written reports.

  • Enabling activities in support of Human Geography production (i.e. writing SOPs and how to guides, training coworkers, etc.)
  • Conduct production phases to support HG products and projects via activities that may include research, discovery, evaluation, extraction , creation, geo-enabling, quality control/review, metadata attribution, source citation, and service enabling and dissemination.
  • Participate in technical exchanges with customers, partners and colleagues onsite and virtually around the globe to ensure production standardization to feature extraction/attribution and HG production.

Basic (required) Qualifications.

  • Active TS/SCI or eligibility and willingness to obtain a POLY is REQUIRED to be considered.
  • 5 or more years’ experience as an HG Analyst or relevant field, to include 1-3 years of demonstrated experience supporting DOD or the IC's GEOINT Mission.
  • Knowledge of Human Geography concepts.
  • Experience in the research, discovery and extraction of geospatial and non-geospatial information.
  • Experience in imagery research, extraction and attribution.
  • Proficiency in use of fundamental ArcGIS Pro software tools in the creation, attribution, schema development and utilization, management, and geo-referencing of data.
  • Experience in geo-enabling non-spatial data.
  • Demonstrated experience to communicate GEOINT products, data, and services to peers and leadership.

Desired Qualifications.

  • BA/BS Degree preferred in Human Geography or GIS, or a related field. Degree may count toward required experience requirements.
  • Knowledge of the regional, cultural and political geography of the region assigned.
  • Experience in using established cartographic principles, geo-referencing, and naming conventions/Romanization in the creation of geo-spatial products.
  • Experience in creating and publishing GEOINT products.
  • Working knowledge of at least one of the foreign languages of the assigned region.
  • Experience producing data and products to customer standards.
  • Experience with open source data harvest, process automation and scripting.
  • Experience with data management, schema development, and data conflation.
  • Experience with Google Earth Engine (GEE).

title: South American Scout
description:
Department: Football Division – Men’s First Team Scouting Team

Hours of Work: Full Time (with flexibility to work during evenings and weekends, including matchdays)

Contract Type: Fixed Term until 30 June 2028

Salary: Attractive Remuneration Package depending on experience

Location: Home-Based in South America, travel to matches and Bodymoor Heath Training Ground (where required)


Closing Date: Sunday 11 October 2026

The Department

Our Men’s First Team Scouting Department provide detailed information, analysis, and recommendations to key stakeholders regarding the recruitment of prospective Men’s First Team players. Our ultimate goal is to contribute to the continued success and growth of our Men’s First Team performance whilst supporting emerging talent operations to maintain a longer-term approach to squad building and succession planning making sure that Aston Villa can continue to compete at world class levels

The Role

An exciting new opportunity has arisen for an experienced scout to join our Men’s First Team Scouting Team. This role will be based in South America, helping to identify and recommend talent capable of contributing to success at the highest level of the game.

As a key member of our Men’s First Team Scouting Team, you will play a leading role in identifying, assessing and recommending talent across South and Central America, including key markets in South America as well as MLS and Liga MX. Combining live and video scouting, you will produce detailed player evaluations, maintain position-specific shortlists and contribute to evidence-based recruitment decisions for both First Team and Emerging Talent targets.

Working closely with recruitment, data and scouting team, you will support the Club's wider recruitment strategy through player identification, assessment and recommendation, presenting findings to senior stakeholders and contributing throughout the scouting process. You will also leverage your professional network to gather market intelligence, conduct character checks and build relationships with player representatives, while setting high standards through the quality of your analysis and scouting output.

You will be available to travel to live games across South America as well as be available to travel to Birmingham on a regular basis (approximately 3 times a year) in order to participate in department meetings.

For further information about the Role, please see the Role Profile.

The Person

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated scouting professional with an exceptional understanding of the South American football landscape and a passion for identifying talent at the highest level of the game.

You must be based in South America or ready to relocate to the region as well as readily available to travel across the continent and be eligible to obtain the Right to Work in South America. Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken), you will possess a proven track record in a senior scouting role, combining expert market knowledge with outstanding player assessment skills across both live and video environments.

You will be a self-starter who thrives working independently, confidently managing extensive travel across the region while building and maintaining a trusted network of contacts throughout the game. With excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and a proactive approach, you will be capable of producing insightful, evidence-based recommendations that influence recruitment decisions across the Club and wider parent group


Why Join Us?

There has never been a better time to join Aston Villa Football Club. Our drive to succeed is visible on the global stage, we are building a family ethos and culture to be proud of, and realising our ambitious plans for the expansion and improvement of our world-class facilities. If you are already excited by this challenge and want to play your part in our historic Club, then you'll be pleased to hear about our amazing staff benefits you'll receive whilst working for us! See our Staff Benefits booklet to find out more.

As part of your application, please upload your CV along with any supporting documentation you feel is relevant to your application

Aston Villa Football Club celebrates the diversity of its Club and embrace equal opportunities for all.

We welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, race, disability, gender reassignment, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, sex and religion or belief.

title: Appraiser
description:
Job Posting Title:

Appraiser

Department:

Assessor

Location:

415 SILVER AVE SW

Pay Range:

$22.81 - $36.01

Close Date:

October 9, 2026

Employees at Bernalillo County enjoy the ability to team up with each other to build a high quality of life for our county residents, communities, and businesses. In addition to being an organization with a strong focus on work-life balance, building a culture of flexibility, learning, and belonging the County offers many benefits. Employees of Bernalillo County enjoy many thoughtful rewards such as, but not limited to generous leave accruals; career development opportunities; remote & flex-work options as appropriate; longevity pay; education assistance program; health benefits; lucrative retirement; and so much more.

The Appraiser performs commercial and residential assessments and appraisals of land, real property, mobile homes, and business personal property. Uses accepted property appraisal methods and computer-assisted mass appraisal (CAMA) systems. Requires detailed research, sound decision-making, and accurate, timely completion of assigned appraisals.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct commercial and residential appraisals of land, real property, mobile homes, and business personal property using accepted appraisal methods and the CAMA system. Compare similar buildings and recent sales to determine market value.

  • Collect property data by measuring and sketching basic dimensions and recording descriptive and analytical information.

  • Determine land values and use digitized land-based maps to support equalization and forecasting.

  • Assist in training less experienced appraisal staff, as needed.

  • Enter and review appraisal data in the computer system to ensure accuracy and consistency.

  • Respond professionally to questions or concerns from property owners and taxpayers.

  • Research and prepare documentation for County Valuation Board and court hearings.

  • Provide support in other areas during peak periods.


*The above information is intended to outline the general nature and scope of the duties required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list and may vary depending on specific job assignments and responsibilities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Public Administration, or a related field.

  • One (1) year of work experience in an appraiser environment, OR

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Current license from the New Mexico Real Estate Commission as an Associate Broker or Qualifying Broker, or licensure from the New Mexico Real Estate Appraisers Board as an Apprentice Appraiser, State Licensed Appraiser, Certified Residential Appraiser, or Certified General Appraiser.

  • One (1) year of experience in property appraisal, real estate sales, or a related field.

  • One (1) IAAO Course may substitute for one-year work experience.


*Any equivalent combination of related education and/or experience may be considered for the above requirements.

SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Successful completion of one (1) IAAO Course within the first year of service.


SCREENING AND COMPLIANCE
The offer of this Bernalillo County position requires compliance with the following:

  • Successful completion of a post-offer employment medical examination.

  • Adherence to all County safety guidelines.

  • Complete all FEMA training(s) assigned to this position.

  • Possession of a valid New Mexico driver’s license by the date of hire and maintenance of a valid license while employed in this position.

  • Complete required supervisor training, if applicable.


WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Essential duties are performed both indoors and outdoors.

  • Indoor duties are performed in a temperature-controlled environment. Worker is exposed to natural weather conditions while performing outdoor duties.

  • Worker may be exposed to various dusts and mists while performing appraisal duties.

  • Indoor duties are typically performed on even and dry surfaces that may be carpeted or tiled with occasional use of stairs. Outdoor duties may be performed on even or uneven surfaces that may be dry or wet. Outdoor duties may be performed on inclines or hills and on surfaces such as natural ground, concrete or asphalt.

  • Duties are performed alone or as part of a select team of individuals.

  • Potential work hazards include frequent driving of vehicle and occasional climbing and descending staircases, ladders and fences. Exposure to wild and domestic animals may be a hazard.


EQUIPMENT, TOOLS, AND MATERIALS

  • Equipment typically used in the performance of office duties include calculator, computer terminal and keyboard, telephone, photocopy machine and telefax machine.

  • Vehicle is used on a frequent basis in traveling from property to property.

  • Equipment, tools, or materials used at appraisal sites include various measuring devices, clipboard, writing instruments, blueprints and architectural scales for sketching of property.

  • Materials typically used in performance of office duties include various documents, writing utensils and an assortment of office supplies and equipment.

  • Safe and proper operation of County vehicle.

title: Asset Management Analyst
description:

Minimum Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in engineering (civil, mechanical, electrical) or related field is required.
  • 5 years of experience in electric utility transmission or substation engineering, or asset management, reliability engineering, maintenance engineering, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of high-voltage substation equipment (115kV to 345kV), circuit breaker technologies, power transformers and diagnostic methods.
  • Working knowledge of asset lifecycle management and reliability-centered maintenance concepts.
  • Familiarity with NERC standards, IEEE/IEC maintenance and testing standards.
  • Experience using asset management or CMM/EAM systems.

title: Head of Revenue Optimisation
description:
About the role

This is a new senior individual-contributor role leading Booming Games' revenue optimisation. Reporting to the CCO and acting as the bridge between Business Insight and Commercial, you will own the strategy for maximising revenue across our partners, markets and game portfolio.

You'll set how the business measures commercial performance, decide where effort and investment should go, and make sure data drives decisions across Account Management, Sales, Marketing and Product.

Responsibilities

  • Strategy and leadership: Define and own the revenue optimisation strategy, set the function's priorities and KPIs, and build the processes needed to deliver it, working through Account Management, Sales, Marketing and BI rather than a dedicated team.
  • Senior commercial partner: Act as a key adviser to the CCO and wider leadership team, bringing clear, evidence-based recommendations on growth, risk and prioritisation.
  • Bridge BI and Commercial: Own the relationship with BI, set commercial data requirements and reporting standards, and ensure the commercial team has the insight it needs to act quickly. Champion automation and AI-assisted analysis to speed up insight.
  • Revenue growth across market teams: Work with the Heads of Account Management and Sales to drive GGR growth through lobby placement, game visibility, promotional tools (free rounds, tournaments, network promotions) and release uptake. Build per-partner growth plans and benchmark partners against peers in the same market.
  • Market and launch performance: Oversee performance of new market entries and game launches, setting 30/60/90-day benchmarks and leading corrective action.
  • Forecasting and planning: Assist with revenue forecasting, support budget and target setting across commercial teams, and report performance vs plan to the executive team and board.
  • Promotional and marketing ROI: Partner with Marketing to measure campaign and promotional effectiveness and direct spend to the highest-return activity.
  • Portfolio strategy: Feed performance insight into the product roadmap and game production decisions, shaping which mechanics, themes and features we prioritise by market.

Requirements

  • A strong understanding of commercial strategy and performance management. iGaming experience (B2B supplier, aggregator or operator) is useful but not essential.
  • Deep understanding of iGaming commercial drivers (GGR, bet volume, RTP, retention, game lifecycle, operator merchandising) and how they vary across markets.
  • Strong analytical background with hands-on command of BI tools, preferably Qlik and Power BI.
  • Credible, confident communicator who can influence senior stakeholders internally and at partners, and turn complex data into a clear commercial story.
  • Commercially minded and action-oriented: insight is only valuable when it changes what the team does.
  • How Success is measured
    • Incremental GGR attributable to revenue optimisation initiatives
    • Like-for-like GGR growth across existing partners and markets
    • New market and game launches performing against benchmark
    • Return on promotional and marketing spend
    • Margin across partner commercial agreements
    • Forecast accuracy vs actuals

Good to know

  • We embrace diversity and equal employment opportunities. We are committed to creating a fair, supportive, and open environment for all.
  • Please understand that we can only consider applicants who are located in the European time zone. (+/- 2 hours). All other applications will be automatically deleted due to the high volume of applicants.

Why Work for Booming Games

Founder led. Impact driven. Employee centric.
At Booming Games, we're reshaping the iGaming world with our remote-first approach. Our rhythm? Thrilling slot games with captivating features and stunning designs released every two weeks - no exceptions! Here, it's all about co-ownership and real growth. Dive into a diverse team where your input powers every game we craft!

  • We’re a 100% remote-first company, offering a best-in-class remote experience
  • Competitive package
  • Family-friendly policies
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Zestful working environment
  • Knowledge sharing opportunities
  • Dynamic culture surrounded by industry experts
  • Company social events for team bonding

title: Leasing Professional - Tuscan Village
location: Novella at Tuscan Village, Salem, NH
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.

Job Description

As a Senior R&D Scientist you will be a key role in the development and validation of innovative bioscience products. In this position, you will work across product development teams to lead system validation activities throughout the product lifecycle, translating scientific expertise and customer needs into effective product solutions.

You will contribute to the design of test strategies, development of validation protocols, and interpretation of complex data while collaborating with colleagues across engineering, quality, regulatory, marketing, and product development.   • Translate customer workflows and user feedback into product requirements and testing approaches.
  • Lead projects and initiatives, balancing technical considerations with business objectives and project timelines.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to support product development, technology evaluation, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide technical guidance and contribute to strategic decisions through scientific insight and evidence-based recommendations.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Degree in Immunology, Cell Biology, Clinical Laboratory Science, or a related scientific discipline, with at least five years of experience in a clinical, research, pharmaceutical, medical device, or related environment.

  • Strong background in experimental design, statistical analysis, data interpretation, and scientific problem solving.
  • Ability to independently execute complex studies and critically evaluate study designs, including sample size calculations and statistical approaches.
  • Demonstrated success leading medium to large projects and delivering results in evolving and fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build consensus and work effectively across diverse teams.

Job Description:

GDIT is hiring a Network Administrator Associate for the Base Infrastructure Modernization (BIM) program at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam (JBPHH) on Oahu, Hawaii. You'll join the site team that operates and maintains the base network, working side by side with our Air Force customer while the base goes through a major network modernization.


What your week looks like

Most days start with health checks. You'll work through the daily O&M checklist, review monitoring and alerts, and check the incident queue for anything that came in overnight. From there you'll pick up tickets, troubleshoot switching, routing, and access problems on enterprise network equipment, and work each one to closure within the contract's service level targets. When a problem is beyond you, you escalate early and with good notes.


A steady part of the job is compliance. You'll help apply STIGs, work findings from vulnerability scans, and keep device configurations current and backed up. Every change goes through a formal process. You'll help plan the work, document it, and carry out approved changes during scheduled maintenance windows, some of which fall on nights and weekends.


You won't spend the whole day at a desk. The team runs preventive maintenance inspections in telecom rooms across the base, supports installs and upgrades tied to the modernization, and works with vendors when hardware fails. You'll also take a turn in the team's on call rotation.


What we expect from you

We want someone dependable who is careful around production equipment. That means following change control every time, documenting what you did so the next person can pick it up, and communicating clearly with the military and civilian customers who rely on this network for their mission. You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to own your tickets, ask good questions, and keep learning. People who do well here grow into senior administrator and lead roles.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED, REQUIRED:
● Active Secret clearance and US citizenship
● Current DoD 8140 qualification (CompTIA Security+ CE or equivalent)
● 1+ years of hands on network experience in an enterprise, DoD, or military environment
● Working knowledge of switching, VLANs, basic routing, and TCP/IP, and comfort working at the command line
● Exposure to STIG compliance and patching
● Willingness to work on site at JBPHH, work in telecom rooms across the base, and support after hours maintenance windows and on call duty

● NOC or SOC experience

● Hands on Juniper Junos or Cisco IOS experience
● Experience working incidents in an ITSM ticketing system

● Military cyber transport or network background

title: CDL OPERATOR
description:
CDL Operator

***Nights Required***

About the Role:

As a CDL Operator within the construction industry, you will play a critical role in ensuring the timely and safe transportation of construction materials, equipment, and supplies to various job sites across the United States. Your primary objective will be to operate commercial vehicles in compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations while maintaining the integrity of the cargo. Responsibilities will include transporting trucks and equipment to and from the project site as well as working alongside TMS crews when not driving a truck or piece of equipment. This work may include assisting with the installation of lighting, signing, ITS, signal, or tolling components on the project. This position demands a high level of responsibility, attention to detail, and commitment to safety to support the overall efficiency and success of construction projects. You will collaborate closely with project managers, warehouse personnel, and site supervisors to coordinate deliveries and pickups, adapting to dynamic schedules and site requirements. Ultimately, your work will directly contribute to the smooth progression of construction operations by ensuring materials arrive on time and in excellent condition.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Valid Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) Class A or B as required by the vehicle type.
  • Clean driving record with no recent major violations or accidents.
  • Minimum of 2 years of professional driving experience, preferably in construction or heavy equipment transport.
  • Ability to pass DOT physical examination and drug screening.
  • Knowledge of federal and state transportation regulations and safety standards.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience operating specialized construction vehicles such as boom trucks, dump trucks, flatbeds, or heavy haul trailers.
  • Familiarity with GPS navigation systems and electronic logging devices (ELDs).
  • Basic mechanical skills for minor vehicle troubleshooting and maintenance.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams.
  • Previous experience working in the construction industry or related fields.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate commercial vehicles such as flatbeds, dump trucks, or tractor-trailers to transport construction materials and equipment safely to designated job sites.
  • Inspect vehicles before and after trips to ensure mechanical soundness and compliance with safety standards.
  • Load and unload materials securely, verifying cargo against delivery orders and reporting any discrepancies or damages.
  • Maintain accurate logs of working hours, vehicle inspections, and delivery records in accordance with Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations.
  • Communicate effectively with dispatchers, site supervisors, and other team members to coordinate delivery schedules and address any issues that arise during transit.
  • Adhere strictly to all traffic laws, safety protocols, and company policies to minimize risks and ensure safe operation.
  • Perform routine maintenance tasks and report any vehicle defects or required repairs promptly.
  • Hands on installation of structures, poles, signs, conduit etc. related to construction projects.

Skills:

The required skills for this role include proficient vehicle operation, adherence to safety regulations, and effective time management to meet delivery deadlines. CDL drivers must utilize their knowledge of transportation laws and vehicle mechanics daily to ensure compliance and prevent breakdowns. Communication skills are essential for coordinating with dispatch and site personnel, resolving logistical challenges, and reporting issues promptly. Preferred skills such as familiarity with GPS and electronic logging devices enhance route efficiency and regulatory compliance. Additionally, mechanical aptitude supports quick identification of vehicle issues, minimizing downtime and maintaining project schedules. Construction knowledge and use of tools to assist in installation of materials related to construction projects.

  • Monitor, analyze, and communicate quality metrics and key performance indicators; identify trends and drive improvement initiatives.

Escalate significant quality risks, compliance concerns, and emerging trends to site and Quality leadership, ensuring timely awareness and decision-making.

  • At least 3 years’ work experience within a Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology or CRO environment.
  • Good understanding of Research activities and processes in Life Sciences.
  • Good knowledge of GLP and GCP (applied to bioanalytical analytical activities including biomarkers and LC-MC methodologies).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work as a team and in a matrix environment.
  • Comfortable working with high level of autonomy, highly proactive and enthusiastic.

description:

The position will be supporting the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC) team with the goal of providing outstanding customer service to FAA customers receiving NISC services throughout the scope of operations.

The Program Manager reports to the Senior Task Order Manager and performs several vital tasks involving managing programs/projects related to the task orders issued by FAA customers. The Program Manager is responsible for ensuring the processes associated with NISC task orders are running efficiently and effective communication is maintained with both Leidos employees and the FAA customer. The NISC team is composed of a very diverse and talented pool of employees with a wide variety of skill sets that support the FAA’s safety mission via the NISC contract.

  • Analyze organizational skill demographics and determine ways to leverage and anticipate existing and future skillsets needed for growth.
  • Coordinate employee recruitment, selection and training; to include identifying, reviewing candidate skills, and screening to ensure candidate qualifications match task order performance work statements.

  • Manage NISC resources to meet budget parameters for varying performance periods on the contract
  • Monitor, analyze, verify and track task order financial information to include employee travel related expenses. This may include providing guidance to subcontractors performing work on MMAC/DC task orders.
  • Coordinate training/travel and other direct costs related to task order accomplishment.
  • Prepare monthly status reports for local and program office use such as the monthly Contract Status Report (CSR) and supporting documentation as required by the FAA.
  • Frequent interface with FAA customer personnel, other contractor personnel, FAA Engineering Technical Officers (ETOs), and other FAA customer representatives.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, and 4+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 2+ years of prior experience.
  • The successful candidate will be versatile and results-driven who can coordinate with multi-disciplined technical teams.
  • Experience conducting research, personnel & process evaluation, studies, and presenting recommendations/solutions related to short and long-term program planning requirements
  • Lead team meetings, complete monthly status reports, and participate in national and regional virtual meetings.
  • Excellent communication, customer relations, and personnel relation skills
  • Provide well-written, organized documentation, consistent with acceptable standards of writing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • NISC program operations to include talent acquisition, job skills required, and experience with working alongside MMAC/DC managers and Enterprise Transportation talent acquisition liaisons
  • Proven ability to define problems, and work within company and customer policies to determine acceptable courses of action that minimize risk to both.

title: Instructor - Education Assistant
description:
We are here to launch, advance, and evolve careers — join us and make an impact.

Job Description


About Bow Valley College

For 60 years, Calgary’s college has grown to prepare 14,000 students annually for meaningful careers in health care, social services, business, technology, and creative industries. Every program has a Work Integrated Learning requirement, ensuring students contribute to the workplace before they graduate. With a strong focus on advanced simulation training and Alberta’s evolving needs, Bow Valley College’s new Health Care Centre of Excellence is working to expand space and programs, aimed at graduating four-times as many health professionals annually by 2036.


Proudly recognized as one of Canada’s Top 50 Research Colleges, we combine innovative learning with hands-on experience. Home to Alberta’s only major e-sports arena and a state-of-the-art digital production hub. Learn more about the opportunities Bow Valley College creates for students, Calgary, and Alberta at .


Position Summary

Join the School of Community Studies as a Casual Instructor – Education Assistant, where you’ll play an important role in supporting students as they develop the knowledge and skills needed for success in the Education Assistant field. You’ll provide high-quality instruction, evaluate student progress, develop and adapt curriculum, and create meaningful learning experiences that support students in achieving their course and program outcomes.


This role requires a commitment to excellence in teaching and the ability to deliver curriculum across diverse learning environments, including in-person, online, blended, and organizational settings. You’ll work collaboratively with students, colleagues, industry stakeholders, employers, government agencies, and community partners to ensure learning remains relevant, responsive, and connected to current practice.


What You'll Be Doing:

Deliver Quality Instruction

Provide engaging, effective instruction in assigned courses while working within the program’s Competency-Based Education model and delivery framework. You’ll use a variety of instructional strategies to respond to student needs and create lesson plans and learning activities that support successful outcomes.


You’ll also contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of the program by:

· Developing and updating curriculum, guides, and rubrics in collaboration with the Learning Design team.

· Evaluating student performance and providing timely progress reports to students and administrators.

· Maintaining accurate and required student and course records.

· Keeping current with changes in best practices and adapting curriculum as appropriate.


Create a Positive Student Learning Experience

Build supportive relationships with students and help them navigate academic challenges throughout their learning journey. You’ll meet with students to discuss concerns related to attendance, conduct, and performance, identify areas requiring additional support, and refer students to the appropriate institutional resources when needed.


You’ll also:

· Work with students to ensure approved accommodations are appropriately supported.

· Refer students to services such as tutoring and counselling when appropriate.

· Identify concerns requiring further follow-up and refer them to the Program Chair.

· Participate in College and departmental activities that promote student success, including orientation and graduation.


Build Relationships and Connect with the Community

Help strengthen connections between the Education Assistant program, the College, and the broader community. You’ll engage with industry and community stakeholders to maintain awareness of current practices and opportunities, while supporting activities that promote the program and student success.


This includes:

· Supporting articulation and transfer activities for students as required.

· Meeting with industry stakeholders and participating in Advisory Networks.

· Attending external community meetings and participating in recruitment events as schedules permit.

· Maintaining professional networks with employers, government agencies, and community partners.


Contribute to the College Community

As an Instructor, you’ll contribute to a culture of continuous learning and professional development. You’ll follow College policies and procedures, complete required professional development and training, and contribute to applied research where appropriate.


Other responsibilities may include participating in special projects and performing other duties as assigned.


What Sets You Apart

You are an educator who is passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences and supporting students in achieving their goals. You bring the ability to deliver curriculum effectively across in-person, online, blended, and organizational learning environments, and understand how to adapt instructional strategies to meet diverse student needs.


You have strong skills in curriculum development, lesson planning, student evaluation, and learner support, with an ability to work within a Competency-Based Education model. You are committed to continuous learning and staying current with best practices so that your teaching and curriculum remain relevant and effective.


You also bring strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with colleagues, industry stakeholders, employers, government agencies, and community partners. You are committed to student success, professional development, and contributing positively to the College community.

· Teaching in diverse and inclusive settings

· Strong understanding of the role of Education Assistants.

· Experience in working directly with Education Assistants across multiple settings

· Knowledge of Competency Based Education in post-secondary education

· Police information check including a vulnerable sector.

· Supervisory experience with practicum students and/or staff is an asset

title: Research Fellow [LKCMedicine]
description:
The Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine) trains doctors who put patients at the centre of their exemplary care. The School, which offers both undergraduate and graduate programmes, is named after local philanthropist Tan Sri Dato Lee Kong Chian. Established in 2010 by Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in partnership with Imperial College London, LKCMedicine aims to be a model for innovative medical education and a centre for transformative research. The School’s primary clinical partner is the National Healthcare Group, a leader in public healthcare recognised for the quality of its medical expertise, facilities and teaching. The School is transitioning to an NTU medical school ahead of the 2028 successful conclusion of the NTU-Imperial partnership to set up a Joint Medical School. In August 2024, we welcomed our first intake of the NTU MBBS programme, that has been recently enhanced to include themes like precision medicine and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, with an expanded scope in the medical humanities. Graduates from the five-year undergraduate medical degree programme will have a strong understanding of the scientific basis of medicine, with an emphasis on technology, data science and the humanities.


The position is supported by the MOE Tier 2 project, "Construct Kidney Organoids with Higher-Order Tissue Architecture for Studying Congenital Kidney Diseases", with the key objective of developing advanced human kidney organoid models to investigate congenital kidney diseases, understand disease mechanisms, and facilitate translational research.

For more details, please view


We are looking for a Research Fellow to support the MOE Tier 2 research project "Construct Kidney Organoids with Higher-Order Tissue Architecture for Studying Congenital Kidney Diseases". The role will focus on human pluripotent stem cell culture, kidney organoid differentiation, genome engineering, disease modelling, molecular and imaging analyses, as well as data interpretation, manuscript preparation, and mentoring junior laboratory members. The appointee will also contribute to the day-to-day operation and scientific progress of the project.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the design and execution of research activities under the MOE Tier 2 project "Construct Kidney Organoids with Higher-Order Tissue Architecture for Studying Congenital Kidney Diseases."

• Develop and apply human pluripotent stem cell-derived kidney organoid models, CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing, and molecular and cellular biology techniques to investigate disease mechanisms.

• Perform and interpret multi-omics, imaging, and functional analyses, including RNA sequencing and single-cell transcriptomic datasets.

• Prepare manuscripts, research reports, grant applications, and present research findings at scientific meetings.

• Supervise and mentor junior researchers, including Research Associates, PhD students, undergraduate interns, and attachment students.

• Contribute to laboratory management, maintenance of shared experimental platforms, and implementation of good laboratory and research practices.


Required educational qualification, experience, skills and competencies:


• PhD degree in stem cell biology, developmental biology, cell biology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline.

• 3-4 years of relevant research experience or demonstrated technical expertise in human pluripotent stem cell biology, organoid models, molecular biology, or disease modelling.

• Strong technical experience in mammalian cell culture, human pluripotent stem cell maintenance and differentiation, molecular and cellular biology techniques, and experimental design.

• Experience with kidney organoid culture, CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing, animal models, histology, microscopy, or next-generation sequencing data analysis will be an advantage.

• Good written and oral communication skills, with the ability to prepare scientific manuscripts, reports, and presentations in English.

• Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation, including statistical analysis and graphical presentation of scientific data. Experience in transcriptomic or single-cell sequencing analysis is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects effectively.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a multidisciplinary research team.

• Highly motivated, responsible, and proactive, with a strong commitment to scientific excellence and willingness to mentor junior laboratory members.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Sr. Technology Consultant - Master Data Management)
description:
Sr. Technology Consultant – Data Engineering & Cloud Operations

Position Overview

As a Sr. Technology Consultant, you’ll be responsible for ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem built on Informatica IDMC (SaaS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Your role bridges the domains of MDM development and data operations — combining engineering excellence with proactive reliability management to deliver trusted, high-quality master data that fuels analytics and business insights across the company.

You’ll work collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile environment, partnering with data engineers, SREs, architects, and business stakeholders to design, monitor, and optimize data pipelines and MDM processes supporting key domains like customer, finance, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, monitor, and optimize MDM SaaS jobs, Informatica IDMC workflows, Control-M, and GCP data pipelines for performance and reliability.
  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native data integration pipelines, supporting both batch and real-time flows using Dataflow, NiFi, Composer, Pub/Sub, and Datastream.
  • Support MDM configurations in Informatica IDMC, including Customer 360, Business Entities, match/merge logic, trust and validation rules, and data quality profiling.
  • Implement proactive SLA-based monitoring and automation to prevent incidents and reduce manual intervention.
  • Conduct performance tuning, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews, driving continuous reliability and process improvements.
  • Collaborate with developers and data consumers to translate business and data quality requirements into resilient, automated technical solutions.
  • Automate maintenance, deployment, and recovery processes using Python, Shell scripting, or Terraform, integrating with CI/CD pipelines (Git-based).
  • Develop and maintain clear technical documentation for pipelines, workflows, and operational runbooks.
  • Stay current with cloud-native MDM, DevOps/DataOps, and data governance trends to enhance the overall maturity of the ecosystem.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, DataOps, or production support for large-scale data or MDM platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC (Cloud MDM SaaS) or equivalent SaaS MDM platform.
  • Familiarity with Customer 360, Business Entity Services, and MDM process design (match, merge, trust frameworks).
  • Strong Python and SQL skills for automation, data processing, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with GCP services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Datastream, Composer, and Dataplex.
  • Experience with ETL and orchestration tools, e.g., NiFi, Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI/IICS).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, and monitoring frameworks; experience using Terraform, Git, Cloud Monitoring, and Alerting solutions.
  • Familiarity with API development and integration (REST, JSON, Node.js, Postman).
  • Working knowledge of data quality, governance, and lineage tracking (IDMC Data Quality, Axon, or equivalent).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, performance tuning, and communication abilities.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with passion for automation, operational excellence, and data reliability.
  • Availability for 24x7 rotational shifts, with strong incident response discipline

Good to Have Skills:

  • GCP Professional Data Engineer or Informatica IDMC / Customer 360 certification.
  • Experience applying DataOps or SRE principles to data ecosystems.
  • Working knowledge of TMF (TeleManagement Forum) standards or reference models.
  • Experience scripting for observability and metrics collection (Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to metadata and lineage management in enterprise environments.

Work Setup

  • Hybrid (Once-twice a month onsite)
  • Shifting schedule
  • Ortigas, Pasig City

title: Sr. Chemist
description:
Company Information

RPM Industrial Coatings Group is home to 11 industry-leading coatings and finishing brands. Our dynamic portfolio includes liquid coatings, powder coatings, touch-up and repair products, sundries, adjuvants, and much more. You’ll find our products around the globe in industries from architecture and automotive to farming, forestry, marine, and more.

RPM Industrial Coatings Group is part of RPM International Inc., a $7.3 billion global company with subsidiaries that are market and industry leaders in specialty coatings, sealants, building materials, and related services. From homes and workplaces to infrastructure and precious landmarks, RPM’s brands are trusted by consumers and professionals alike to help build a better world.

The RPM Innovation Center of Excellence is a state-of-the-art research and development facility that was designed to foster collaboration and harness the collective expertise found across our businesses. Features include liquid and powder application labs, resin and analytical labs, a sample production area, and a formulation lab, among other resources. It also serves as a destination for onsite customer training and application trials.

At TCI Powder Coatings, we’re more than a premier supplier of powder coatings – we’re a team of innovators, problem-solvers, and customer champions, serving clients across North America. As an industry leader, we take pride in our people, products, and unmatched service, and we’re looking for talent individuals ready to help us grow even further.

Our commitment to excellence starts with our team. From Sales to Technical Service, Manufacturing to Customer Service, we offer exciting career opportunities that align with your strengths, ambitions, and goals. Whether you’re looking to kickstart your career or take it to the next level, we provide clear paths to individual growth and overall company success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Sr. Powder Chemist (Metallics/Special Effects) to join our Research & Development team and play a key role in developing, optimizing, troubleshooting, and commercializing powder coating technologies. This is an opportunity for a technical expert to have a meaningful impact on new product development, customer solutions, manufacturing performance, and the continued advancement of our powder coating portfolio.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of chemistry, formulation, processing, application, and customer performance. You will have the technical independence to solve complex formulation challenges while partnering closely with R&D, manufacturing, quality, sales, customers, and raw material suppliers.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize powder coating formulations for a variety of performance requirements, applications, substrates, and end-use markets.
  • Select and optimize resins, curing agents, pigments, fillers, additives, and other raw materials to achieve targeted coating properties, appearance, durability, and processing characteristics.
  • Design and execute laboratory experiments to evaluate formulation variables, identify root causes, and efficiently solve complex technical problems.
  • Formulate bases required to color match metallic standards.
  • Perform in-house metallic bonding to provide powder samples to customers.
  • Develop an expert understanding of the relationship between formulation chemistry, powder processing, application conditions, and final coating performance.
  • Work with powder manufacturing processes—including premix, extrusion, cooling, grinding/classification, and powder handling—to optimize product quality and consistency.
  • Evaluate coating performance through laboratory testing, including properties such as adhesion, hardness, impact, flexibility, chemical resistance, corrosion resistance, weatherability, gloss, color, appearance, cure response, and other application-specific requirements.
  • Troubleshoot coating and manufacturing issues and determine appropriate formulation or process adjustments.
  • Support scale-up from laboratory development through pilot and commercial production, ensuring formulations are robust, reproducible, and commercially viable.
  • Lead technical aspects of new product development and commercialization projects, establishing project scope, experimental plans, milestones, and technical deliverables.
  • Translate customer and market requirements into practical formulation and product-development strategies.
  • Provide technical support to manufacturing, quality, sales, customer service, and other internal teams.
  • Partner with customers and suppliers to investigate technical issues, evaluate new raw materials, and develop solutions to challenging coating applications.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, formulation documentation, test results, and project information.
  • Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to less-experienced laboratory personnel.
  • Promote a culture of safety, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and disciplined experimentation.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in coatings, powder coatings, polymers, or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Direct experience developing thermoset powder coatings.
  • Experience with metallic bonding process and expertise with various metallic and special effect pigments.
  • Experience with epoxy, polyester, hybrid, acrylic, polyurethane, or other powder coating chemistry.
  • Experience with powder coating extrusion and manufacturing processes.
  • Knowledge of powder coating application technologies, including electrostatic spray application and curing behavior.
  • Experience with architectural, industrial, automotive, general industrial, protective, or other powder coating applications.
  • Experience with accelerated weathering, corrosion testing, chemical resistance, and other coating-performance evaluations.
  • Experience working with customers and raw material suppliers on technical development or troubleshooting projects.
  • Demonstrated experience with coatings formulation and product development.
  • Strong understanding of coating chemistry, raw materials, formulation principles, and coating performance testing.
  • Ability to independently design experiments, interpret data, troubleshoot problems, and make sound technical decisions.
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between raw materials, formulation, processing, application, and finished-product performance.
  • Demonstrated experience taking formulations from laboratory development through scale-up and commercialization.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across R&D, manufacturing, quality, sales, and other functions.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join an R&D organization where your technical expertise can directly influence the products we develop and the customers we serve. You'll work on challenging chemistry and have the opportunity to collaborate across the organization while helping advance our powder coating technologies.

If you're a coatings chemist who enjoys solving complex problems, developing new technology, working directly with customers and manufacturing, and seeing your formulations become commercial products, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing data pipelines and architectures. S/he will ensure that data flows seamlessly from multiple sources into databases, data lakes, or warehouses and is processed in a way that supports business analysis and decision-making. The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering skills, experience with data processing frameworks, and the ability to optimize and scale large data systems.

At Stratpoint, we enjoy the autonomy, lack of bureaucracy, and the freedom to experiment but without the chaos. We’re like a startup but with adult supervision.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that support data collection, transformation, and integration from various sources.
  • Maintain databases, data warehouses, data lake ensuring data integrity, scalability, and reliability.
  • Implement efficient ETL/ELT (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to automate data collection, cleaning, and transformation tasks.

  • Demonstrating a strong track record of interacting with the business and technology partners to drive the requirement, technical process into acceptance criteria.

title: Director, Technology Regulatory Compliance
description:
About this role

Role purpose

BlackRock is seeking a Director of Technology Regulatory Compliance to develop and operate a global compliance programme addressing the rapidly evolving regulation of technology, artificial intelligence, data, cyber security, digital operational resilience and technology service providers.

The role will cover BlackRock’s distinct but interconnected responsibilities as:

  • A regulated financial institution that develops and uses technology, including AI, data and cloud-based capabilities;
  • A customer of third-party technology and ICT services, including cloud, managed service, software, data and AI providers; and
  • A provider of technology and data services to clients, including through Aladdin, eFront and Preqin.

This dual client-and-provider perimeter creates regulatory obligations that extend beyond a traditional financial-services compliance model. The successful candidate will therefore combine technology expertise, regulatory interpretation and programme-building capability. They will work alongside the responsibilities of key BlackRock divisions such as the Aladdin business, Legal, Information Security, Risk Management and Technology & Operations.

This role will translate complex and sometimes overlapping global requirements into a coherent, risk-based Technology Compliance Programme. This will include governance, regulatory inventory and applicability, control frameworks, product compliance, assurance, regulatory engagement, management information and evidence of compliance. As such, this role requires a technology regulatory specialist who can operate credibly with engineers, technology product owners and cyber professionals as well as collaborating with key stakeholders whilst providing effective challenge and assurance from a Compliance perspective.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead compliance oversight for BlackRock's technology businesses (Aladdin, eFront and Preqin), supporting the development of new technology products and capabilities by assessing them against relevant regulatory requirements and liaising with specialist compliance teams where financial regulatory considerations arise.
  • Assess the regulatory implications of providing technology or data services to clients and identify the obligations that may attach directly to BlackRock as a technology or data (including AI-service) provider.
  • Design and implement a global, risk-based Technology Compliance Programme covering technology, AI, Cloud, data, cyber security, and operational & digital resilience requirements, aligning to associated technology-driven regulation (e.g. DORA, EU AI Act, NIS2, US NIST, Australia Cyber Security Act).
  • Establish the programme’s mandate, scope, governance, risk taxonomy, standards, procedures, control objectives and reporting arrangements.
  • Maintain a global inventory of current and emerging technology-related laws, regulations, standards and supervisory expectations. Translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear business, product, technology and control requirements whilst balancing obligations with market practice.
  • Define Compliance’s role relative to the, Legal, Technology Risk Management, Information Security, and other control functions, ensuring clear accountability and avoidance of control duplication.
  • Continuously review and develop the compliance program based on changes to regulatory risk, business strategy, product development and supervisory priorities whilst also taking into consideration changes to relevant laws and regulations. This includes ensuring that changes to IT services and infrastructure are evaluated, authorised, and managed in accordance with regulatory standards.,
  • Develop a structured approach to identifying and managing obligations arising from BlackRock’s different roles as a financial institution ,technology provider, and AI provider/deployer
  • Support the development and maintenance of IT compliance policies, technical standards, and secure configuration baselines. Ensure these are embedded into solution design, procurement, and operational processes, and are enforced through effective automation and monitoring capabilities
  • Support engagements with financial, technology, AI, and cyber-security regulators globally.
  • Represent Compliance in interactions with financial, technology, AI and cyber-security regulators globally, leading responses to regulatory enquiries, examinations, thematic reviews and supervisory engagements, and providing credible challenge and advocacy on BlackRock’s approach to technology, AI and digital resilience regulation.

Leadership and stakeholder management

  • Act as a senior technology-regulatory subject-matter expert within Global Compliance.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across Technology, Product, Information Security, Data, AI, Legal, Risk, Operations and Internal Audit.
  • Influence technical and commercial decisions while maintaining appropriate Compliance independence.
  • Build and lead a specialist team as the programme develops.
  • Develop technology and digital-regulation capability across the broader Compliance function.
  • Represent Compliance in relevant architecture, product, AI, data, cyber, resilience and third-party governance bodies.

Technical and professional capabilities

  • Strong understanding of modern enterprise technology, including cloud architecture, APIs, data platforms, software-development lifecycles, and distributed service models.
  • Working knowledge of cyber-security and resilience concepts, including secure development, vulnerability management, recovery, penetration testing, and incident response.
  • Ability to read technical documentation, architecture diagrams, control descriptions, and testing results.
  • Experience in designing and implementing regulations into technical and operational requirements.
  • Experience designing risk taxonomies, control libraries, obligation mappings, and assurance methodologies.
  • Understanding of technology-provider and software supply chains, including subcontracting and concentration risk.
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to present complex issues succinctly to senior executives and Boards.
  • Credibility with engineers and technologists, combined with independence of judgement and a willingness to challenge.
  • Technology and cyber-risk management, including control frameworks and technical assurance.
  • Cloud, software, data-platform, or AI governance.
  • Advising on the regulatory obligations of technology providers as well as customers of technology.
  • Engaging with regulators, external auditors, clients, and senior governance forums.
  • Leading global programmes across multiple jurisdictions and legal entities.
  • Experience with enterprise investment technology, financial data, portfolio-management platforms, risk systems or private-markets technology would be particularly valuable.

Qualifications

  • The role should not require every candidate to hold the same qualification. Strong candidates may come from technology, cyber, engineering, risk, audit, legal or compliance backgrounds.

Candidate profile

  • The successful candidate is likely to be:
  • A technology regulatory specialist that understands global requirements
  • Desirable specialist knowledge of key Global, EU and UK technology regulations (e.g. EU AI Act, DORA, EU Cyber resilience act etc)
  • Comfortable moving between regulatory text, technical architecture and senior management decision-making
  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, while prepared to challenge where regulatory risk is not adequately controlled
  • Capable of building a programme from first principles rather than administering a mature, pre-existing framework
  • Effective in a global, matrixed organisation with multiple accountable control functions
  • Comfortable operating in areas where regulatory expectations are developing and precedent is limited.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.


BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

title: Agile Coach and Release Train Engineer

As an Agile Coach and Release Train Engineer (RTE), you will drive execution and transformation across the organization by leveraging frameworks, including Scaled Agile (SAFe), Scrum, and Kanban. As an RTE, you will act as a servant leader and chief coach for the Agile Release Train (ART) planning, facilitating, and executing Program Increment (PI) Planning, managing program-level risks, resolving cross-team dependencies, and driving continuous flow.

You’ll help to bring standard methodologies into the organization and partner closely with senior leadership to establish lean agile routines and practices that transform the organization to run Agile at scale, integration and continuous development, DevSecOps, and delivery automation.


The Agile Coach and Release Train Engineer will drive discussions with executive leads, team leads, and management while keeping the collective ART focused and tracking on PI commitments, pace, continuous improvement, and quality.

Supports and executes plant specific maintenance strategies to achieve the plants CBN goals and overall maintenance performance KPI’s. Works closely with production to ensure schedules are met and all planned work is completed and communicated in a timely fashion. Inspects operating machines and equipment for conformance with operational standards. Reviews production, quality control, and maintenance reports and statistics to plan and modify maintenance activities. Develop and implement daily job plans and communicate previous days performance against those plans to Maintenance Manager and Reliability Manager. Help support and coach line centric teams and veLOCity standards.


Position Responsibilities


Leadership & Team Supervision

  • Directly supervise maintenance mechanics supporting assigned areas.
  • Assign daily work, set priorities, and manage Mechanic coverage across both lines.
  • Conduct shift huddles, performance discussions, and routine check-ins with the team.
  • Enforce all safety standards, including LOTO, PPE, hot work, and safe work procedures.
  • Enforce Precision Maintenance practices on all jobs.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and development opportunities to improve Mechanic skill levels.
  • Support other Team Leaders across the facility.

Maintenance Operations

  • Ensure timely completion of PMs, PdMs, and corrective maintenance for all equipment in assigned area.
  • Review maintenance requests, prioritize based on criticality, and coordinate work to minimize production impact.
  • Ensure work orders are accurately completed in the CMMS, including parts, labor, and failure codes.
  • Support and guide troubleshooting efforts on mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
  • Coordinate maintenance work during planned outages, line changeovers, and shutdowns.
  • Support and own Defect Handling in assigned area.

Operational Support & Communication

  • Act as the primary maintenance contact for Production Supervisors in the assigned area.
  • Communicate equipment status, planned work, and risk areas during daily operations meetings.
  • Lead rapid response to breakdowns on either line and ensure proper escalation and documentation.
  • Work cross-functionally to balance production priorities with maintenance needs.
  • Represent Maintenance as necessary in Leadership meetings.

Reliability & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify reliability risks and lead implementation of corrective actions.
  • Participate in and lead root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues.
  • Track and report maintenance KPIs such as downtime, MTTR, MTBF, and PM compliance.
  • Support 5S, TPM, and other continuous improvement activities to reduce downtime and improve equipment performance.

Resource & Materials Management

  • Manage parts usage and ensure availability of critical spares for equipment.
  • Verify proper use and maintenance of tools, equipment, and shop resources.
  • Supervise contractors performing work on either line to ensure safety and compliance.
  • Assist with planning and forecasting maintenance resource needs.

Basic & Preferred Qualifications

Qualifications

  • 5 -10 years industrial maintenance experience, 1-2 years leadership or supervisory responsibilities.
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills; electrical and controls experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise teams and coordinate maintenance activities across multiple lines.
  • Experience with CMMS systems and maintenance planning processes.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand and walk. The employee is occasionally required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, and feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; taste and smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. The employee will be exposed to a noisy environment that varies from hot to cold in temperature. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. title: Sr Design & Release Engineer (DRE) - Interior Cockpit
description:
ABOUT SLATE

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Slate is looking for a dynamic, experienced Sr Design & Release Engineer (DRE) – Interior Cockpit to join our growing team. This role will be responsible for leading the design, development, and integration of phone holder, iPad holding mechanisms, and cockpit trim component systems integrated within the vehicle cockpit for Slate vehicles. This includes mechanical retention systems, adjustability features, durability performance, and user interaction (HMI) considerations to ensure robust performance across all operating conditions. The individual will be responsible for understanding the vehicle's technical specifications and performance targets. Utilizing the APQP process and supporting documentation, this position will ensure Slate's quality, performance, and regulatory objectives are achieved and sustained throughout the vehicle lifecycle.


WHAT YOU GET TO DO

  • Lead design, development, validation, and launch of phone/iPad holder/interior plastic trim systems including spring-loaded clamps, detent mechanisms, friction-based retention systems, and other injection-molded plastic trim systems
