Shape the Future of Technology at BMO


At BMO, we're driven by a shared purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. Technology is a critical enabler of that vision, helping us deliver exceptional experiences to customers and employees while

building a more digitally connected future. We are seeking a highly strategic and innovative Solution Architect to join our Service, Operations & Support (SOS) organization within Engineering & Platforms.


The SOS organization serves as the face of technology for internal users across the bank, supporting critical capabilities including IT Service Management (ITSM), Service Desk operations, infrastructure and network operations, end-user technology services, and enterprise support platforms. As a Solution Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and delivering technology solutions that enhance operational excellence, strengthen security, improve employee experiences, and accelerate innovation across BMO.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced architect who thrives on solving complex enterprise challenges, influencing technology strategy, and shaping the future of a modern banking technology ecosystem spanning cloud, on-premises, SaaS, AI-enabled, and emerging technology platforms.

What You'll Do

As a Solution Architect, you will design and architect enterprise technology solutions that seamlessly integrate business processes, applications, data, infrastructure, and security. You will provide architectural leadership across strategic initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and enterprise standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain architecture strategies, roadmaps, standards, and key architectural artifacts for the assigned portfolio.
  • Lead solution architecture for complex enterprise initiatives across cloud, on-premises, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
  • Create technical solution designs and recommendations aligned with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to align technology investments with organizational goals and strategic priorities.
  • Identify technology risks, dependencies, and architectural challenges, driving proactive mitigation strategies and informed decision-making.
  • Participate in requirements reviews to ensure business and system requirements can be translated into effective technical architectures.
  • Research emerging technologies, perform proof-of-concepts, and evaluate innovative solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value.
  • Provide architectural guidance and insights to support business cases, investment decisions, and technology modernization programs.
  • Lead and influence cross-functional teams through complex transformation initiatives and enterprise-wide programs.
  • Ensure architecture decisions align with security, compliance, governance, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Design scalable, sustainable, and resilient technology solutions that support long-term enterprise growth.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, technology executives, and project stakeholders.
  • Drive integration across diverse technology ecosystems while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
  • Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies, incorporating innovation and continuous improvement into architecture strategies.
  • Apply expert problem-solving and critical thinking to resolve highly complex and ambiguous business and technology challenges.
  • Take measured risks while protecting the bank through sound application of BMO's Risk Management Framework, policies, standards, and regulatory obligations.

Why BMO?

At BMO, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most impactful technology initiatives in the industry. You'll collaborate with talented professionals across technology, engineering, operations, security, risk, and business teams to solve meaningful challenges at enterprise scale.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting

  • Architect solutions that support thousands of employees across the enterprise.
  • Influence the future direction of workplace technology, IT service management, automation, and operational excellence at BMO.
  • Work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, AI Agents, and modern DevOps platforms.
  • Participate in transformational initiatives that leverage cloud, automation, artificial intelligence, and next-generation support technologies.
  • Gain exposure to executive leadership and play a key role in strategic technology decision-making.
  • Join an organization committed to innovation, inclusion, continuous learning, and professional growth.
  • Help shape the future of technology at one of North America's leading financial institutions while creating meaningful impact for employees, customers, and communities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, or related technology leadership roles.
  • Post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proven experience serving as a technical leader across multiple enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in designing and implementing cloud, on-premises, SaaS, and hybrid technology solutions.
  • Strong background in security architecture, infrastructure technologies, enterprise integration, and data lifecycle management.
  • Experience developing technology roadmaps, architecture standards, and solution governance practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities, including presenting recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences.

Technical Expertise

Experience with many of the following technologies:

  • Infrastructure and Operations Technologies
  • DevOps Tooling including:
    • GitHub

    • Jira

  • Security and Governance Frameworks
  • Data Management and Enterprise Architecture Practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering AI-focused solutions and transformational initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures, and emerging AI frameworks.
  • Experience with enterprise automation and intelligent service management platforms.
  • Industry certifications in Cloud Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Security, or IT Service Management.

Our Purpose at BMO

At BMO, our Purpose to Boldly Grow the Good drives everything we do. We believe that technology has the power to transform how we serve customers, support employees, and strengthen communities. As a Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in delivering innovative, secure, and scalable solutions that advance BMO's digital transformation journey and help shape the future of banking technology.

Join BMO and help build what's next.

title: Information System Security Officer
description:
Information System Security Officer

The Opportunity:

Cyber threats are everywhere, and the constantly evolving nature of these threats can make understanding them seem overwhelming to a varied government IT ecosystem. In all of this “cyber noise”, how can these organizations understand their risks and how to mitigate them? The answer is you. We need your knowledge as an information security risk specialist to help break down complex threats into manageable plans of action.


As an Information System Security Officer on our team, you’ll work with our federal clients to discover their cyber risks, understand policies, and develop a mitigation plan. You’ll get technical, environmental, and personnel details from our clients and SMEs to assess the entire threat landscape. Then, you’ll help your team guide your client through a plan of action with presentations, whitepapers, and milestones. You’ll work on translating security concepts for your client so they can make the best decisions to secure their mission-critical systems. This is your opportunity to take an active role in information security while growing your skills in cybersecurity and risk mitigation. Work with us as we protect our client's cyber infrastructure.


Join us. The world can’t wait.


You Have:

  • Experience supporting the development of security plans or packages for Assessment and Authorization (A&A) of IT systems Authority to Operate (ATO), including the implementation and assessment of cybersecurity controls
  • Ability to accurately relate requirements and document requirements within the appropriate security document or within the RMF system, and coordinate with the program, other systems, and security personnel
  • Ability to create tactics, techniques, procedures, whitepapers, standard operating procedures, workflows, system data flows, and architectural diagrams
  • Ability to analyze RMF policies
  • Top Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED and 10+ years of experience with information assurance or cybersecurity, or Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience with information assurance or cybersecurity

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Xacta or JCAM
  • Experience reviewing NESSUS or ACAS vulnerability scans and reviewing audit logs, including Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVA)
  • Experience providing network or system administration or computer operations
  • Experience with Windows and Linux systems
  • Experience supporting the Intelligence Community
  • Knowledge of cloud architecture and virtualization
  • Possession of excellent interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • CISSP, CISM, CAP, or CASP+ Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.


Work Model
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

description:
The AEGIS program at Leidos is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager who will be responsible for ensuring the successful completion of NASA and Kennedy Space Center project engagements in accordance with the AEGIS Statement of Work, established budgets, customer expectations, and industry best practices.


These engagements typically involve the multi-year delivery of Information Technology (IT) services, including systems integration for imagery, data transport systems and distribution, specialized voice systems, NASA documentation, and configuration management administration.


The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in project management, interpersonal and team-building skills, and the ability to collaborate on and manage technical or business projects, processes, and deliverables. The candidate will also have the ability to recommend solutions, develop strong customer relationships, and drive a high level of customer satisfaction.


The Senior IT Project Manager will work collaboratively across project engagements with minimal direct supervision while coordinating effectively with others to successfully execute assigned tasks and project requirements.


Join us at AEGIS—where the sky is NOT the limit!


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide management and oversight in support of NASA IT COMM and OCIO projects as assigned by the Director of Mission Communication Services.
  • Maintain controlled area access training as assigned to facilitate entry to controlled areas, working within elevated (heights) work areas, hazardous and clean room locations.
  • Develop, implement, maintain, and improve organization and operational system business processes, procedures, and standards that promote cross-element standardization.
  • Identify project risk and mitigate that risk keeping the project on track.
  • Interface and collaborate with team members, NASA Government leadership and other support contractor teams in the delivery of services to successfully complete assigned projects in support of NASA and Kennedy Space Center and Launch Operations supporting Exploration Ground Systems for Artemis and commercial space flight customers.
  • Participate in lifecycle project management including requirements analysis, design, and implementation as well as timely, accurate reporting.
  • Coordinate with other contractors and supporting groups at KSC.
  • Prepare monthly activities report in support of contract deliverables including daily time reporting for AEGIS.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8 years of IT project management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with business management processes, documentation, budget planning and reporting, and customer service.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with NASA technical and operational teams to understand procurement requirements and recommend procurement decisions based on those requirements.
  • Ability to develop deliverables, presentations, project plans, and spreadsheets, with exceptional proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong proficiency in Microsoft Project, including an understanding of Waterfall schedules.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with peers, management, operational and technical teams, NASA Government customers, and partner contractors.
  • Strong facilitation, consensus-building, decision-making, creative problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to conduct meetings, multitask, prioritize work, and manage deliverables in an interrupt-driven environment.

About the role:

BMO Canada Wealth Digital is accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its customer-facing digital platforms to enhance client experiences, improve operational efficiency, and enable innovative wealth management solutions. We are seeking an experienced AI Delivery Director to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic AI initiatives that support the evolution of our Wealth Management digital capabilities.


This is a senior delivery leadership role requiring the coordination of cross-functional teams across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Business organizations. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the delivery of secure, compliant, and resilient Multi-Agent AI solutions that leverage enterprise AI capabilities, including the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and AI Observability platforms.


The AI Delivery Director will provide end-to-end leadership across the delivery lifecycle, from intake, discovery, and prioritization through implementation, deployment, adoption, and business value realization by adopting and utilizing AI tools in SDLC. Working closely with engineering leaders, product owners, architects, and executive stakeholders, the role will ensure AI-enabled solutions are delivered on schedule, aligned with enterprise standards, and integrated effectively within the broader technology ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Technology Delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
  • Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
  • Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
  • Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
  • Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.

2. AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership

  • Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
  • Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
  • Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
  • Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
  • Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.

3. Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration

  • Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
  • Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
  • Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
  • Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
  • Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.

4. Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery

  • Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
  • Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
  • Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
  • Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
  • Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.

5. Quality, Risk and Responsible AI

  • Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
  • Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
  • Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
  • Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.

6. Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership

  • Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
  • Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
  • Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
  • Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
  • Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

Key Success Measures

  • Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
  • Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
  • AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
  • Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
  • Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.
  • Measurable client adoption, experience, business value, and risk outcomes delivered in partnership with the Product Owner.
  • Effective financial, capacity, vendor, and technical-debt management.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Expert-level technology delivery leadership in large, complex, regulated environments, with accountability for multiple teams and production outcomes.
  • Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and delivery, cloud-native engineering, APIs, integration, identity and access, data services, telemetry, resilience, and DevSecOps.
  • Mastery of advanced Agile, product operating models, value-stream management, Lean flow, Scrum or Kanban, portfolio planning, CI/CD, test automation, and evidence-based delivery metrics.
  • Ability to challenge constructively, make decisions under ambiguity, translate technical complexity into business implications, and influence senior executives.
  • Commercial and financial acumen, including technology investment, capacity, vendor, contract, and delivery-performance management.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and talent-development skills.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, engineering, architecture, platform, or product technology leadership, including senior leadership accountability.
  • Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale digital products or platforms from strategy through production and ongoing operation.
  • Demonstrated delivery of AI/ML or generative AI solutions in production, ideally involving multi-agent systems or other complex AI-enabled client experiences.
  • Significant experience with Microsoft Azure and modern software engineering practices in a regulated enterprise.
  • Experience in wealth management, brokerage, digital investing, banking, or similarly regulated financial services is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional internal and partner teams through complex dependencies and high-stakes releases.
  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; relevant advanced degree or certifications are considered assets.
  • Experience in Wealth Management or Capital Markets AI space (highly desirable) or Financial Institutions or Technology firms.
  • Domain knowledge of investment, securities, trading from a technology perspective, having worked in such ecosystems.

Leadership Expectations

  • Act as an owner: accountable for outcomes, not activity or coordination alone.
  • Put clients, safety, quality, and sustainable value ahead of pace without evidence.
  • Create clarity: make responsibilities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery confidence visible.
  • Lead with technical credibility while empowering engineering and product leaders closest to the work.
  • Build trust through candor, transparency, inclusion, disciplined follow-through, and continuous learning.

description:

  • Your internal recruitment contact is Iona Magee via iona.magee@fca.org.uk.

About the FCA and team


We regulate financial services firms in the UK, to keep financial markets fair, thriving and effective. By joining us, you’ll play a key part in protecting consumers, driving economic growth and shaping the future of financial services in the UK.

We are currently seeking a skilled individual to join the Benchmarks and Credit Rating Agencies Supervision team within the Capital Markets Department. The Capital Markets Department sits within SPC division at the FCA and is responsible for both benchmark and credit rating agencies supervision and policy.

SPC oversees firms and individuals (supervision), creates and reviews the rules by which they operate (policy) and identifies and remedies ineffective competition in markets (competition).


The Benchmarks and Credit Ratings Supervision Team is responsible for supervising UK-regulated benchmark administrators and CRAs in line with the applicable regulatory requirements and the FCA’s Approach to Supervision. Benchmark administrators produce benchmarks that are used across financial markets. Where they perform this role effectively, market participants can rely on accurate and representative measures of underlying market activity. CRAs play a key role in providing an assessment of the creditworthiness of governments, corporates and other issuers of securities. Where they perform this role effectively, investors are well-informed on the risks of investing in these assets and hence, capital is more efficiently allocated. These outcomes contribute particularly to the FCA’s statutory objective for market integrity and its consumer protection objective.

Role responsibilities

  • Build trusted supervisory relationships with benchmark administrators, using constructive challenge and direct engagement to bring about positive change and effective regulatory outcomes
  • Oversee strategic supervisory initiatives and engage with senior executives to improve governance, controls, methodologies and risk management practices
  • Develop specialist expertise across a diverse portfolio of benchmarks, from globally significant indices to those supporting key sectors of the UK economy
  • Identify, assess and respond to emerging market risks, applying sound judgement to deliver proportionate interventions that enhance market integrity and confidence
  • Partner with colleagues across the FCA to bring together diverse insights, shape supervisory priorities and inform key regulatory decisions
  • Collaborate with UK and international regulatory partners to address complex market issues and help deliver fair, effective and resilient financial markets
  • Share expertise, present insights and contribute to a collaborative learning culture, enhancing the FCA’s supervisory effectiveness while building skills and experience for future leadership opportunities

Skills required

Minimum:


  • Prior experience of working in a regulatory and/or financial services sector with professional experience related to indices and benchmarks
  • Prior experience of working with the key risks related to indices and the wider financial ecosystem
  • Prior experience in applying diagnostic skills, whether gained in industry, legal and/or financial services

Essential:


  • Good understanding of benchmark administrators’ business models, core processes and the potential risks associated with benchmark administration activities
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and deliver projects effectively within agreed timelines while managing multiple priorities
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present clear, concise and well-reasoned arguments to a range of stakeholders
  • Ability to make informed and timely decisions, acting on own initiative to identify key issues, navigate complexity and escalate matters where appropriate
  • Well-developed organisational skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and manage changing demands effectively
  • Flexible and responsive approach, with the ability to adjust to changing requirements and adapt working styles to meet evolving business needs
  • Ability to work collaboratively, supporting colleagues and contributing to the successful delivery of shared objectives

Benefits


  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Colleagues spend a minimum of 50% of their working time in the office each month (60% for Directors and Executive Directors) across our London, Leeds and Edinburgh offices.
  • Non-contributory pension (8–12% depending on age) and life assurance at eight times your salary
  • Private healthcare with Bupa, income protection and 24/7 Employee Assistance
  • 35 hours of paid volunteering annually
  • A flexible benefits scheme designed around your lifestyle

Quality – The consumer is our boss, quality is our work and value for money is our goal.
Responsibility – As individuals, we demand total responsibility from ourselves; as associates, we support the responsibility of others.
Mutuality – A mutual benefit is a shared benefit; a shared benefit will endure.

Freedom – We need freedom to shape our future; we need profit to remain free.

Functional

Problem solving skills - Demonstrates a strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems. Translates problems into practical solutions.
Client service skills - Consistently ensures the team provides the client with attentive, courteous and informative service. Gains and shows personal satisfaction from delivering great service.
Intellectual ability - Accurately and consistently follows instructions delivered in an oral, written or diagram format. Can provide directions.

Computer skills - Comfortably and confidently uses a computer and specialized software. Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, etc.

Initiative – shows willingness and aptitude to use own discretion in taking appropriate steps in finding solutions to problems; presents options and ideas to enhance current processes or procedures. Takes on additional responsibility when both big and small tasks need to be done.
Integrity – Firmly adheres to the values and ethics of Banfield Pet Hospitals. Exhibits honesty, discretion, and sound judgment.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.
Ability to be confident around pets (i.e., dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, etc.)
Client needs and work volume may often require more than 40 hours per week to complete essential duties of this job. This position requires special hours including working weekends and evenings.

title: Consultant - Finance Track - Evergreen - All Levels
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Finance Consultant to join our Consulting Services team. As an evergreen posting, we hire across experience levels, prioritizing the right match for our team. If you have a strong Deltek Finance background and you are looking for a place to do good work with good people, we want to hear from you regardless of where you are in your career.

Finance Consultants at FSP work with clients to implement, configure, and optimize Deltek Vision and Vantagepoint Finance modules. You will be a trusted advisor to your clients - the person they call when they need to understand how their system works, why something is not working the way they expected, or how to get more out of their investment. You will manage engagements, build relationships, and deliver implementations that actually stick.

The right candidate for this role understands project-based accounting, knows their way around the Deltek Finance suite, and is comfortable being in front of clients. We can help with all the rest.

What You Will Do

Lead Client Implementations

You will work with clients to implement and configure Deltek Finance modules - from initial scoping and discovery through go-live and beyond. That means running sessions, making configuration decisions, managing scope, keeping projects on schedule, and making sure clients understand the tool when you are done.

Build Real Client Relationships

Our clients are not tickets in a queue - they are ongoing relationships. You will be the person they trust to tell them the truth about their system, help them think through a decision, and get them unstuck when something is not working. At more senior levels, you will manage those relationships at the executive level and serve as an escalation point for the broader team.

Contribute to the Practice

We are a small firm, which means that everybody contributes. What that might look like is: mentoring less-experienced colleagues, contributing to internal knowledge resources, participating in proposals and scoping conversations, and occasionally representing FSP at conferences or webinars. The more senior you are, the more of this you do - but even at the Staff level, you are a contributor, not just an attendee.

Grow in the Direction That Fits You

We have built out formal tracks for Finance, CRM, and Development consulting because we want people to be able to grow in the direction that plays to their strengths. If you are interested in developing a specialty in Resource Planning, a particular Finance module, or even in bridging into development work on the technical side of Deltek, there is a path for that here. We do not hand you a career plan on day one, but we take development seriously and we build structure around it.

What You Bring

We hire across experience levels, so not everything below is required at every level. What we are always looking for is solid Deltek Finance knowledge, a genuine comfort with client work, and the kind of professional judgment that comes from real-world experience.

The Foundations

  • Experience with Deltek Vision or Vantagepoint in a Finance or accounting role - either as a consultant or as a power user on the client side.
  • Working knowledge of project-based accounting concepts - billing, revenue recognition, GL structure, and how those things live inside Deltek.
  • Comfort working directly with clients - you can run a meeting, manage a difficult conversation, and keep a project moving without constant oversight.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - you can explain a complex configuration decision in plain English to someone who does not live in the system.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field - or the kind of hands-on experience that makes the degree irrelevant.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience delivering Deltek implementations as a consultant, not just as an end user.
  • Depth in specific Finance modules - billing, multi-company, revenue generation, project reporting, or any of the specialized modules in the Deltek suite.
  • Experience writing proposals, scoping engagements, or managing a client portfolio.
  • A track record of mentoring colleagues.
  • Any exposure to Deltek's development-adjacent tools - custom UDICs, workflows, or BI reporting - is a genuine differentiator.

Experience Levels

We are intentionally hiring across a range of experience levels. Here is a rough guide to how we think about each:

Staff

1-5 years of Deltek Finance experience. You work under the guidance of more senior consultants and are building toward independent delivery. You know the system and you are ready to apply that knowledge in a client-facing consulting role.

Senior

5-7 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a consulting delivery role. You lead implementations for less complex clients independently, manage the client relationship, and are starting to draft proposals and mentor Staff Consultants.

Principal

7-10 years of experience, with 3 or more years in consulting. You lead complex engagements independently, own executive-level client relationships, and contribute meaningfully to proposals, business development, and staff mentoring.

Senior Principal

10+ years of experience, with deep expertise across the Deltek Finance suite. You lead the firm's most demanding engagements, help shape how we deliver, and play an active role in developing the next generation of consultants at FSP.

Compensation

We offer competitive salaries based on experience and level, with a discretionary bonus program. The range for this role is $75,000 to $140,000 depending on experience, with bonus on top of that.

We believe in paying people well and giving them the flexibility and autonomy to do their best work.

Benefits

We offer a benefits package that matches or exceeds what larger firms can offer.

  • Health insurance - FSP covers 100% of your individual premium and 50% of dependent coverage in our most popular plan, but offer multiple UnitedHealthcare plan options including HSA-eligible plans. Coverage begins the first of the month following your hire date.
  • 401(k) with match - company matches 100% on the first 3% of your contribution and 50% on the next 2%, for an effective 4% match on the first 5% you put in. Eligible after 3 months.
  • PTO - up to 160 hours per year in your first five years, 200 hours after that. Available after your 90-day probationary period. Plus 8 paid holidays and 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually.
  • Equipment allowance - up to $250/month reimbursement for phone, internet, and cell service for roles with travel and demo requirements.
  • Flexible schedule - fully remote with flexible hours. We care about the work getting done well, not when you start your day.
  • Dental and vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability, FSA, EAP, and voluntary supplemental coverage also available.

Life at Full Sail Partners

Fully Remote, Actually

We do not have a headquarters that everyone is quietly expected to commute to. We are a remote-first company and have been for a long time. Some client work requires travel, and we will be upfront about what that looks like for this role - but your day-to-day is yours to manage from wherever you work best.

Small Enough to Matter

At FSP, you are not a resource in a staffing model. You are a person with a name, a reputation, and a direct line to leadership. When you do good work, people notice. When you have an idea, you can say it out loud and expect a response. We are intentionally the kind of firm where your contribution is visible.

Depth Over Breadth

We focus on Deltek. That is it. We are not trying to be everything to everyone - we are trying to be the best Deltek partner our clients have ever worked with. That means our consultants develop real depth in a specific platform, with real clients who have real problems, and they build expertise that is genuinely valuable in the market.

Growth That Reflects Your Strengths

We have built formal career tracks because we think people deserve to know what advancement looks like and what is expected of them at each level. But beyond the titles, we try to find ways for people to grow in the direction that fits them - whether that is deeper technical expertise, client leadership, or something in between. If you are someone who grows, we will find ways to make room for it.

How to Apply

If this sounds like a place you want to work, we would like to hear from you, Using the 'Apply' option above, submit your information to us.

We review applications on a rolling basis. Because this is an evergreen position, response time may vary - but we read everything and we will follow up if there is a fit.

Full Sail Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

Onze praktijk in Nijmegen is een moderne verwijspraktijk, waar patiënten terecht kunnen voor diverse specialistische behandelingen. Ons team beschikt bestaat uit 8 kaakchirurgen, welke ook allen staflid zijn van het UMC st. Radboud Nijmegen.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
AI-oplossingen bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat ze veilig, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar draaien bij klanten is iets anders. Daar kom jij in beeld.

Als DevOps Engineer binnen het EIFFEL Solutions Lab bouw je het fundament onder de technologiegedreven dienstverlening van Team EIFFEL. Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-oplossingen, digitale proposities en innovatieve diensten snel, veilig en schaalbaar naar productie kunnen. Niet voor één business line, maar voor heel Team EIFFEL. Van Legal en Finance tot Data, Technology en Engineering: jij maakt de stap van idee naar impact mogelijk.

Dit ga je doen

Je werkt samen met collega's uit het EIFFEL Solutions Lab aan innovatieve oplossingen op het snijvlak van business, technologie en AI. Samen ontwikkelen, valideren en schalen we proposities die klanten helpen slimmer, sneller en toekomstbestendiger te werken.

Jij zorgt ervoor dat die oplossingen daadwerkelijk draaien.

  • Je ontwikkelt en beheert CI/CD-pipelines voor snelle en betrouwbare deployments.
  • Je automatiseert infrastructuur met Infrastructure as Code en zorgt dat nieuwe omgevingen binnen enkele uren beschikbaar zijn.
  • Je maakt AI-oplossingen, data-platformen en digitale proposities productie-klaar.
  • Je richt monitoring, logging en alerting in zodat prestaties, beschikbaarheid en kosten continu inzichtelijk zijn.
  • Je borgt security, compliance en toegangsbeheer binnen onze oplossingen.
  • Je werkt samen met architecten, developers, IT en technologiepartners om nieuwe proposities succesvol live te brengen.
  • Je automatiseert terugkerende werkzaamheden en versnelt de ontwikkelcyclus van het hele team.
  • Je draagt bij aan een schaalbaar platform waarop toekomstige EIFFEL Solutions kunnen worden gebouwd.

Je bent fit for the job als je...
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt als DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer of vergelijkbare rol.
  • Ervaring hebt met Azure, AWS of GCP.
  • Sterk bent in CI/CD tooling zoals Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions.
  • Ervaring hebt met Terraform, Docker en Kubernetes.
  • Kennis hebt van observability, monitoring en incidentmanagement.
  • Begrijpt wat AI-, data- en cloudworkloads vragen van een moderne infrastructuur.
  • Ervaring hebt met security, privacy en compliance binnen complexe of gereguleerde omgevingen.
  • Technologie ziet als middel om sneller klantwaarde te realiseren.

Dit krijg je van ons

Wij bieden je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een van de strategische groeipijlers van Team EIFFEL. Je werkt aan state-of-the-art AI-oplossingen en technologieplatformen die direct bijdragen aan de toekomst van onze dienstverlening.

Je krijgt:

  • Directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van nieuwe technologiegedreven proposities.
  • Ruimte voor ondernemerschap binnen een sterk groeiende organisatie.
  • De mogelijkheid om te werken op het snijvlak van business, technologie en AI.
  • Samenwerking met experts uit verschillende disciplines en business lines.
  • De vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om impact te maken op organisatie-, klant- en marktniveau.

  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
Dit zijn wij

Het EIFFEL Solutions Lab is de plek waar nieuwe technologiegedreven proposities ontstaan. Hier combineren we de domeinkennis van Team EIFFEL met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI, data en technologie.

Samen met Venture Builders, architecten en engineers ontwikkelen en valideren we oplossingen die inspelen op actuele vraagstukken van klanten. Wat werkt, schalen we door binnen Team EIFFEL. Zo bouwen we aan een toekomst waarin vakmanschap en technologie elkaar versterken en structureel meer waarde creëren voor klanten, professionals en onze organisatie.


Team EIFFEL is een toonaangevende multidisciplinaire professional services organisatie met ruim 3.000 professionals actief binnen Legal, Finance, Data, Technology, Engineering en Projectmanagement.

Onze ambitie is helder: uitgroeien tot de leidende tech-enabled professional services organisatie van Nederland. Daarom investeren we volop in innovatieve proposities die vakmanschap combineren met data, AI en technologie.

Het EIFFEL Solutions Lab speelt hierin een sleutelrol. Hier bouwen we de oplossingen van morgen. Niet als experiment, maar als schaalbare dienstverlening die daadwerkelijk impact maakt voor klanten én Team EIFFEL.

Deze skills komen van pas
  • Probleemoplossing
  • Data-analyse

Je bent iemand die snelheid en betrouwbaarheid niet als tegenpolen ziet. Je houdt van bouwen, automatiseren en verbeteren. Tegelijkertijd weet je verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden om oplossingen succesvol live te brengen.

Daarnaast ben je:

  • Verbindend en sterk in samenwerken.
  • Oplossingsgericht en pragmatisch.
  • Analytisch en gestructureerd.
  • Creatief in het automatiseren van processen en het oplossen van technische uitdagingen.
  • Ondernemend, proactief en resultaatgericht.
  • In staat om technische keuzes begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan verschillende stakeholders.

title: IT Service Desk Analyst
description:
About Us:


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

The Enterprise IT Service Desk Analyst’s role is to provide our internal customers with an exceptional experience for every contact. The IT Service Desk Analyst will assist our customers with all aspects of their PC and mobile device-related challenges. This includes resolution of incidents that may result in installing, diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, or upgrading the PC, its peripherals, or the software in use. The IT Service Desk Analyst always strives to exceed the customer’s expectations by providing solutions whether in person, remotely by telephone, e-mail, or other means necessary to deliver consistent and superior service.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):

  • Provide world class customer support.
  • First level response to incident tickets.
  • Accept and solve support issues.
  • Migrate and deploy PC’s/ PC images.
  • Function and communicate in a global support team.
  • Respond to ticketing incidents by priority and assignment.
  • Support customers through superb communication in person, by telephone and or email.
  • Fully document resolution, and communication history to customer in incident ticket.
  • If appropriate, convert resolution to knowledge base document to share with other team members.
  • Diagnose, analyze, and resolve PC and software problems for internal customers through incident ticketing system.
  • Analyze root cause and implement corrective solutions.
  • Deploy new equipment to customers from unpacking to delivery.
  • Collaborate with the infrastructure team to ensure efficient operations.
  • Assist in resolving issues with customers on server-based software products.
  • When working on any PC, ensure the latest security settings, antivirus, and application patches are applied.
  • Use tools and applications for monitoring PC performance and provide performance statistics and reports.
  • Maintain inventory of all hardware and software.
  • When necessary, contact third-party support and PC equipment vendors.
  • Maintain knowledge of current IT trends and advancements.
  • Responsible for other opportunities as required.
  • Full time – Five days a week - In the office position (Service Desk is the face of IT)
  • On-call availability and some evening and weekend hours.

Job Specifications:

  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong customer relationship skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and knowledge of IT hardware and software.
  • Ability to conduct research into software issues and products as required.
  • Strong organizational skills with keen attention to detail.

Required Education and Experience:

  • An associate degree in the field of business administration, computer science, or management information systems and/or 3-5 years of related work experience is preferred.
  • A+ certification is desired.
  • Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Supervisory/Responsibility:

Individual contributor w/no direct reports


Work Environment:

This is an office position.


Position Type:

This is a regular, full-time position with frequent overtime. Must be able, available, and willing to work more than 40 hours per week, including scheduled and unscheduled overtime.

Travel:

Travel could be up to 15% (out of town) as needed for remote support.


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those performed in the job duties. The employee sits at a desk and uses a computer for prolonged periods of time. Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

Disclaimer:

The above information in this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It’s not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this job. This job description is subject to change at any time.

We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process. ​

  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks, take initiative, and work independently with minimal direction in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive, hands-on, and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership for delivering a positive workplace experience.
  • Ability to work additional hours when operationally required.

What You Will Do

Workplace Operations

  • Support daily workplace operations and conduct routine workplace inspections using established procedures, manuals, and checklists.
  • Inspect, record, escalate, and follow through on cleaning, repair, maintenance, and workplace presentation issues until resolution.
  • Coordinate new-hire onboarding and associate departures, including inductions, welcome kits, locker allocation, and building access cards, as applicable.
  • Support workstation moves, office changes, business continuity activities, and the consistent application of workplace standards.
  • Process business cards, staff name tags, and other office print requests.
  • Understand the operation and basic care requirements of office equipment, including coffee machines, dishwashers, microwaves, refrigerators, and similar appliances.

Vendor & Facilities Coordination

  • Coordinate maintenance activities with vendors, service providers, and building management, including raising and monitoring service tickets where applicable.
  • Monitor vendor performance and support the effective delivery of contracted workplace services.
  • Process purchase requests and supplier invoices in Coupa accurately and within required timelines.
  • Process and coordinate courier, mail, delivery, and related logistics requests.

Hospitality & Workplace Services

  • Coordinate hospitality requests, including catering, events, meeting-room setups, and office activities.
  • Maintain meeting rooms and ensure they are refreshed and ready after each use, including resetting furniture and identifying cleaning or maintenance needs.
  • Support the daily readiness and cleanliness of kitchen and pantry areas and equipment.
  • Conduct office-supplies audits and manage the efficient purchasing, storage, restocking, and inventory control of workplace, pantry, and consumable supplies.

Associate Experience & Service Delivery

  • Create a positive day-to-day workplace experience by responding to associate requests and providing practical support for the use of office facilities and services.
  • Guide associates in the use of Gartner workplace technologies, office-space platforms, and security systems.
  • Act as a central point of coordination for workplace and front-of-house requirements from associates and guests.
  • Build strong workplace relationships and proactively identify opportunities to improve the associate experience.

Guest, Client & Visitor Experience

  • Welcome clients, visitors, and associates in a professional manner, understand their requirements, provide general information, and connect them with the appropriate Gartner contact.
  • Answer front-of-house enquiries clearly, positively, and professionally, ensuring a high standard of customer care.
  • Ensure visitors and associates follow visitor management, office access, and security requirements.
  • Act as the central communication link between associates, visitors, and the Global Real Estate team for workplace and front-of-house requirements.
  • Maintain front-of-house and common areas so they remain clean, functional, safe, and guest-ready at all times.

Administration, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate workplace documentation, operational records, checklists, and service information.
  • Produce operational reports and provide updates on workplace issues, service performance, and required actions.
  • Support continuous-improvement initiatives that strengthen service quality, efficiency, and the overall workplace experience.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise a high level of integrity when handling documents and information.

Teamwork & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Work closely with the Global Real Estate team to support the effective delivery of workplace experience and front-of-house services.
  • Provide backup support within the staffing structure and, where appropriately trained and authorized, cover relevant duties of another team member during absence or sickness to maintain service continuity.
  • Build effective working relationships with associates, clients, visitors, building management, vendors, and internal teams to achieve the objectives of the role.

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Conduct routine safety inspections, report incidents, and escalate hazards or compliance concerns in accordance with applicable procedures.
  • Maintain first-aid supplies and support workplace emergency-readiness requirements.
  • Serve as a First Aid Officer and/or Fire Warden, subject to completion of required training and formal appointment.
  • Support the maintenance of an appropriate number of trained First Aid Officer and Fire Warden volunteers within the office.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Construction - Billboard Installer
description:
Would you like to see a different part of your city every day from a bird’s eye view? Our Lamar office in Tyler, Texas is now hiring a new Operations crew member to help us bring outdoor advertising campaigns to life for brands in Tyler, TX and surrounding areas. This job is action-packed, and we provide all the training and equipment to start your career in the outdoor advertising industry.

The purpose of this position is to install and maintain billboards, including the installation of advertisements, maintenance of structures, and the upkeep of billboard cosmetics. This position most often works as part of an installation crew.

Why Lamar?

Want a career that takes you above the everyday? As part of Lamar’s billboard construction and operations crew, you’ll experience the city from a bird’s-eye view while building and maintaining the structures that keep communities informed. Join a team that values safety, teamwork, and adventure—every single day. See our operations crew in action over on YouTube.
Lamar is a certified Great Place to Work, with 88% of employees in agreement. Lamar Advertising has also been named as a “Best Company to Work For” in U.S. News & World Report’s annual ranking.
  • Learn more about us on our official YouTube channel.

      • A Monday - Thursday, 6:00 am - 4:30 pm work schedule
      • An hourly rate of $18/ hour
      • 120 hours of paid time off (PTO) that increases with tenure
      • 12 paid company holidays, including President's Day and Juneteenth
      • A comprehensive 6-week training program

      • A people-first culture that invests in connection, community involvement, and transparency around employee feedback

      What we are looking for in YOU:

      • Good communication skills. Ability to speak and read English fluently
      • Must be willing to work and get along well with others
      • Basic computer skills including Internet navigation and Microsoft Word & Excel
      • Ability to comply with Lamar safety standards while performing work
      • Ability to work from ladders and to carry a ladder and/or other tools to the worksite from vehicle

      • Working knowledge of fabrication skills and techniques

      • General knowledge of Lamar, Department of Transportation (DOT), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) safety regulations

      • Ability to climb heights and work at heights above ground safely
      • Ability to document installations, through photographs and written logs
      • Skill in the practical applications of mathematics, in relation to construction and operations tasks
      • Skill in setting priorities which accurately reflect the relative importance of job responsibilities

      Education and experience:

      • A high school diploma or equivalent is required
      • A valid driver’s license is required
      • Ability to complete OSHA 10-hour Construction course required
      • Preferred certifications, depending on location need: CDL/Non-CDL, Crane, Signal, Rigging, or LDD
      • Previous experience working at heights up to 200 ft. above ground preferred

      Candidates with a disability in need of an accommodation to fulfill our application requirements should email recruiting@lamar.com.

      A day in the life:

      Installing and maintaining all Billboards

      • Installing and maintaining all Billboards
      • Remove and hang flexes, remove and hang vinyl’s, cut and prepare flexes and vinyl’s for installation, cut, prepare and install copy on Tri-Visions
      • Maintain structures-repairs include but not limited to: tightening bolts, painting steel structures, repairing trim and various parts of the sign face and structure, change light bulbs as needed, paint structures, assemble structures and faces when required.

title: Freight Handler Part-Time
description:
Starting Rate of Pay: $ 21.16 per hour
Shift Time: 1700-2100

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Transport freight across dock area to/from trailers for loading to trailers.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Perform freight handling using appropriate motorized and manual equipment, including but not limited to: forklift, pallet jack and hand truck.

  • Verify documentation matches freight description (e.g. type, weight, hazardous materials), using current electronic or manual system.

  • Secure freight inside trailers using appropriate tools and supplies (e.g. pallets, straps, rope).

  • Recoup/repair damaged freight when necessary.

  • Verify and complete required documentation and reports.

  • Assist customers with freight and freight documentation as needed.

  • Perform hostling duties if required.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as required.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent, preferred.

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Prior experience in warehousing, freight handling and/or fork lift operations preferred.

  • If hostler/yard mule duties required, experience preferred.

  • Ability to count and perform basic math, with or without a calculator.

  • Basic written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to lift/carry hand freight of varying weights several times a week, to lift dock plates weighing approximately 100 pounds, and to open trailer doors requiring approximately 75 pounds of lift force, up to several times per day or more.

  • Ability to bend, twist, squat, pushing/pulling freight throughout shift.

  • Ability to work independently and/or as a team member.

  • Previous dock/warehouse experience preferred.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Dock environment; exposure to varied weather conditions, exhaust, fumes, dust, noise.

  • Hours may vary due to operational need.

  • Frequent contact with service center personnel; fast-paced, deadline oriented.
