  • Lead the evolution of RedRover into an AI-first firm by actively applying emerging technologies to improve performance, speed, and insight. Build and scale the systems, talent, and processes required to support continuous innovation—while remaining hands-on where it matters most.
  • Build the organization to support technology and innovation.

  • Deep expertise leading digital strategy across paid social, PPC, SEO, UX/UI, digital campaign management, and optimization; comfortable being hands-on when needed.
  • Extensive experience running split-testing at scale with measurable performance lift.
  • Proven ability to develop and manage comprehensive digital reporting and dashboard systems.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills with multidisciplinary digital teams, including international talent.
  • Proficiency with GA4, GTM, Search Console, HubSpot, Unbounce, SEMRush (or equivalent).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially simplifying complex data into decisions.
  • Demonstrated alignment with RedRover’s Pack DNA: Results-Driven, Tenacious Ownership, Agents of Change, Self-Disciplined & Accountable, Positive Culture Builders and Highly Coachable.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with B2B categories such as manufacturing, professional services, technology, logistics, or industrial markets.
  • CRO and landing-page optimization expertise.
  • Experience building repeatable testing frameworks or playbooks for teams.
  • Strong familiarity with WRIKE or comparable PM tools.

Why RedRover

We’re a high-performance, culture-driven B2B agency that guarantees outcomes and backs it with relentless optimization. You’ll lead a pack that cares about results and about each other.

Benefits include: competitive compensation, healthcare/dental/vision, generous PTO that grows with tenure, vacation expense reimbursement, pet insurance, daycare reimbursement, fitness benefits, paid parental leave, retirement contributions, and flexible hours.

title: Software Engineer II, Elastic File System (EFS)
description:
Amazon EFS provides fully managed, elastic file storage that scales from gigabytes to petabytes without provisioning or management overhead. Customers rely on it for everything from simple web serving to large-scale analytics and ML training pipelines.

We're looking for engineers who want to work on distributed storage systems that serve real workloads at significant scale. You'll tackle challenges in replication, consistency, and fault tolerance. You'll operate what you build.

Key job responsibilities
What you'll work on:
- Distributed systems design: consensus protocols, replication strategies, failure handling
- Systems-level programming for storage engines and critical data paths
- Operating services at scale: performance tuning, debugging production issues, capacity planning
- Building tooling and automation that makes a small team effective at running large infrastructure

A day in the life
Tech environment: Java, C/C++, Rust, Go, and internal AWS systems. You'll work across the stack, from low-level optimization to service architecture. We're investing in AI-assisted development for systems engineering and you'll help define how we use it, from code generation to operational automation.

This role includes on-call responsibilities. We take operational excellence seriously: automated remediation, thorough runbooks, and a culture of fixing root causes rather than firefighting the same issues repeatedly.

EFS is built entirely in Boston. We're working on new capabilities that expand how customers use file storage with AWS. The team operates with a customer focus, working backward from real problems to build storage infrastructure that customers depend on for their most critical workloads.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

description:

Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics - Open Finance

Overview

The Strategic Customer Analytics - Open Finance team serves as a trusted analytics partner to Mastercard's Open Finance clients, helping customers understand performance, identify growth opportunities, and maximize value from Mastercard's data and connectivity solutions. The successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership teams to develop performance reporting, investigate trends, uncover opportunities, and communicate findings through compelling analyses and presentations.

- Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related experience.
- Experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, strategy, or a related analytical role.
- Strong SQL and data analysis skills with experience working with large-scale datasets.
- Experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
- Exceptional analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present insights to executive audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience translating technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.

Nice-to-Have

- Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, open banking, open finance, or digital platforms.
- Knowledge of A/B testing, performance measurement, forecasting, or statistical analysis techniques.
- Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks.
- Experience working in client-facing analytics or consulting environments.
- Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve reporting and analytical workflows.

Job Description:

GDIT is hiring a Network Administrator Associate for the Base Infrastructure Modernization (BIM) program at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam (JBPHH) on Oahu, Hawaii. You'll join the site team that operates and maintains the base network, working side by side with our Air Force customer while the base goes through a major network modernization.


What your week looks like

Most days start with health checks. You'll work through the daily O&M checklist, review monitoring and alerts, and check the incident queue for anything that came in overnight. From there you'll pick up tickets, troubleshoot switching, routing, and access problems on enterprise network equipment, and work each one to closure within the contract's service level targets. When a problem is beyond you, you escalate early and with good notes.


A steady part of the job is compliance. You'll help apply STIGs, work findings from vulnerability scans, and keep device configurations current and backed up. Every change goes through a formal process. You'll help plan the work, document it, and carry out approved changes during scheduled maintenance windows, some of which fall on nights and weekends.


You won't spend the whole day at a desk. The team runs preventive maintenance inspections in telecom rooms across the base, supports installs and upgrades tied to the modernization, and works with vendors when hardware fails. You'll also take a turn in the team's on call rotation.


What we expect from you

We want someone dependable who is careful around production equipment. That means following change control every time, documenting what you did so the next person can pick it up, and communicating clearly with the military and civilian customers who rely on this network for their mission. You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to own your tickets, ask good questions, and keep learning. People who do well here grow into senior administrator and lead roles.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED, REQUIRED:
● Active Secret clearance and US citizenship
● Current DoD 8140 qualification (CompTIA Security+ CE or equivalent)
● 3+ years of hands on network experience in an enterprise, DoD, or military environment
● Working knowledge of switching, VLANs, basic routing, and TCP/IP, and comfort working at the command line
● Exposure to STIG compliance and patching
● Willingness to work on site at JBPHH, work in telecom rooms across the base, and support after hours maintenance windows and on call duty

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
● NOC or SOC experience
● Experience with ACAS or Nessus vulnerability scanning
● Hands on Juniper Junos or Cisco IOS experience
● Experience working incidents in an ITSM ticketing system
● CCNA, JNCIA, ITIL 4 Foundation, or a DoD 8140 advanced certification such as CompTIA SecurityX
● Military cyber transport or network background


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:
● 401K with company match
● Comprehensive health and wellness packages
● Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
● Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications
● Cutting edge technology you can learn from
● Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays

title: Director Of Technology Engineering & Data Services
description:
Director of Technology Engineering & Data Services

Company : Staff4me

Job Type : Full Time

Cebu City, Philippines

Job Description

Description

The Director of Technology Engineering & Data Services is accountable for CallTek's software engineering, data analytics and automation, and enterprise architecture capabilities. The role leads the teams that design, build, integrate, govern, and continuously improve the applications, platforms, data products, automations, and architectural standards that support internal operations and client solutions.

This leader converts business priorities into executable product and engineering roadmaps, establishes disciplined delivery practices, and ensures that new solutions are secure, maintainable, observable, cost-effective, and ready for production support. The Director is expected to raise delivery predictability while encouraging innovation, reuse, automation, and responsible adoption of artificial intelligence.

Organizational Scope

Development

  • Lead application development, platform engineering, integrations, APIs, internal tools, client-facing solutions, quality engineering, release practices, and technical maintenance.
  • Establish consistent software development lifecycle standards covering requirements, design, coding, testing, security review, documentation, deployment, support handoff, and post-release measurement.
  • Manage delivery capacity, prioritization, product ownership, estimation, technical debt, source control, environment strategy, and engineering quality.

Data Analytics & Automation

  • Lead reporting, dashboards, data pipelines, operational analytics, business intelligence, process automation, workflow orchestration, and AI-enabled productivity solutions.
  • Establish data definitions, ownership, quality controls, access rules, lineage, retention, documentation, and trusted sources for management and client reporting.
  • Measure realized benefits such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction, error reduction, improved decision quality, revenue support, and service performance improvement.

Enterprise Architecture

  • Own enterprise architecture principles, target-state designs, technology standards, integration patterns, solution reviews, reference architectures, and technology lifecycle decisions.
  • Reduce fragmentation and unnecessary duplication by promoting reusable services, approved platforms, secure patterns, interoperability, and clear system ownership.
  • Maintain current-state and target-state views of major applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure dependencies, identity boundaries, and security requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Engineering and Data Strategy: Develop and maintain a multi-year roadmap for applications, platforms, data, automation, and architecture aligned with company strategy, client needs, operational pain points, and investment priorities.
  2. Portfolio and Product Governance: Create a transparent intake, prioritization, capacity, and portfolio-review process. Clarify product owners, business outcomes, scope, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and benefits for each initiative.
  3. Software Delivery Excellence: Establish disciplined SDLC and DevSecOps practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, environment management, CI/CD, release controls, secure development, and technical documentation.
  4. Architecture Governance: Lead solution architecture reviews and approve technology patterns, integrations, data models, non-functional requirements, platform selections, and exceptions to standards.
  5. Data Governance and Analytics: Ensure that dashboards and reports use defined metrics, trusted sources, quality checks, appropriate access, and clear business ownership. Reduce manual and conflicting reporting.
  6. Automation and AI Enablement: Identify and prioritize automation and AI opportunities that improve productivity, service quality, insight, or client value. Require responsible controls, human oversight, security review, and measurable outcomes.
  7. Integration and Platform Reliability: Ensure that APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and applications are observable, supportable, resilient, and designed with capacity, performance, error handling, recovery, and lifecycle management in mind.
  8. Release and Production Readiness: Partner with Technology Operations on operational acceptance, monitoring, runbooks, support ownership, rollback plans, security and compliance requirements, knowledge transfer, and post-release stabilization.
  9. Security and Privacy by Design: Embed identity, least privilege, secure coding, logging, data protection, vulnerability management, privacy, retention, and compliance requirements into design and delivery.
  10. Technical Debt and Lifecycle Management: Maintain a visible technical-debt and end-of-life register, prioritize remediation based on business and operational risk, and prevent unsupported or undocumented solutions from becoming permanent dependencies.
  11. Vendor and Partner Management: Evaluate software, cloud, data, AI, development, and integration partners based on architecture fit, security, supportability, commercial value, lock-in risk, and total cost of ownership.
  12. People Leadership: Develop managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and automation specialists; clarify career paths; strengthen technical leadership; and build a culture of quality, collaboration, curiosity, documentation, and accountable delivery.
  13. Executive and Client Communication: Present roadmaps, investment cases, delivery status, risks, architecture decisions, product outcomes, and innovation opportunities to executives, business stakeholders, and clients.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Ten or more years of progressive experience across software development, application engineering, data, analytics, automation, integration, architecture, or related technology disciplines.
  • Five or more years leading managers, architects, engineers, developers, analysts, or automation teams with responsibility for delivery, quality, staffing, and technical direction.
  • Demonstrated success creating engineering standards, product or portfolio governance, architecture review processes, release disciplines, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of modern application architecture, APIs and integrations, relational and analytical data platforms, cloud or hosted services, security by design, testing, CI/CD, observability, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience delivering solutions for a BPO, MSP, NOC, contact center, multi-client services business, or complex internal operations environment is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate technical choices, tradeoffs, risk, cost, and business value to executives, clients, product owners, operations teams, and technical specialists.

Preferred Certifications and Experience

  • PMP, Scrum/Agile, TOGAF, cloud architecture, data engineering, security, database, software engineering, or comparable professional certifications.
  • Experience with API-first architecture, workflow automation, data governance, AI/ML or generative AI solutions, low-code/no-code platforms, and enterprise integration.
  • Experience modernizing legacy systems, consolidating fragmented reporting, establishing reusable platforms, and creating clear production support models.

Benefits

  • Health Insurance and health subsidy
  • Transportation, rice allowances
  • Vacation leave
  • Sick leave
  • Meals and snacks
  • Bonuses

title: Staff Systems Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.

Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!

At Credit Acceptance, the Staff Infrastructure Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for technical leadership of core infrastructure platforms, with a primary focus on compute, containerization, virtualization, and storage. This role is designed for an engineer who is deeply hands-on and systems-oriented, with a strong ability to solve infrastructure challenges through automation and code. This role provides technical leadership and mentorship but does not include people management responsibilities.

The Staff Infrastructure Engineer owns complex, cross-cutting infrastructure challenges, setting technical direction, and reducing operational friction across the environment. This role partners closely with engineering leadership, cloud, network, security, and application teams to design and evolve resilient, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure platforms.

A defining characteristic of this role is a strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation mindset. The Staff Infrastructure Engineer approaches infrastructure as a software problem—using code, APIs, and automation to deliver repeatable, scalable outcomes, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery. In addition, this role is expected to explore and adopt emerging techniques such as AI-assisted and agent-based workflows where they meaningfully improve infrastructure operations and engineering productivity.

Outcomes and Activities

  • This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member
  • Provide technical leadership across compute, storage, networking, Linux, Windows and K8S platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Design and implement enterprise-scale infrastructure solutions that are maintainable, cost-effective, and aligned with business strategy.
  • Act as a force multiplier by identifying systemic issues, simplifying complex systems, and reducing operational toil through automation.
  • Define and drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent.
  • Lead the evaluation, experimentation, and adoption of AI-enabled tooling and agent-based workflows for infrastructure operations, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, and Application teams to design end-to-end solutions spanning data center and cloud environments.
  • Perform impact analysis for complex changes and proactively identify risk across multiple systems and platforms.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point, leading root cause analysis and driving durable corrective actions.
  • Define, document, and socialize engineering standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
  • Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Influence infrastructure and platform roadmaps and long-term strategy in partnership with engineering leadership.
  • Participate in incident response, disaster recovery planning, and on-call rotations as needed
  • Share technical design decisions and reference architectures for assigned domains, partnering with Infrastructure leadership for prioritization and alignment
  • Reduce operational toil, incident recurrence, or manual effort through platform improvements and automation
  • Improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, or delivery velocity through sustained, measurable outcomes

Competencies: The following competencies describe how you will be successful in this role:

  • Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
  • Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
  • One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
  • Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering roles with deep hands-on ownership of compute, virtualization, and storage platforms.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing, operating, and troubleshooting enterprise-scale compute and virtualization environments, including capacity planning, lifecycle management, availability, and performance tuning.
  • Experience leading and supporting large-scale migration initiatives from on-premises data centers to Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Strong experience with enterprise storage systems, including:
    • Block storage architectures and performance characteristics
    • File and scale out NAS platforms
    • Object storage architectures, including S3 compatible platforms, data durability models, lifecycle management, and cost optimization strategies
    • Design and operation enterprise-grade file services supporting a remote workforce, including secure access patterns, performance optimization, availability, and integration with identity, endpoint, and security controls
  • Hands-on experience operating and integrating storage and data protection platforms such as Pure Storage, Cohesity, and Qumulo, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
  • Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, with a strong bias toward solving problems through code rather than manual processes.
    • Proven use of tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Git, or similar
    • Experience designing reusable modules, workflows, and automation patterns
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals sufficient to design and troubleshoot infrastructure across compute, storage, and network boundaries.
  • Experience designing and operating infrastructure in virtualized and/or hybrid environments, with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across platforms and architectures.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and lead response efforts for critical infrastructure incidents.

Preferred

  • Experience working in hybrid data center and cloud environments.
  • Experience with AI-assisted operations, agent-based automation, or applying AI/ML tools to infrastructure workflows.

description:

  • Ensure that process documentation is in place and maintained as relevant and consistent to reflect changes in business operations and risk exposure and, supports the execution of internal controls and compliance requirements.
  • Maintain the relationship with our offshore Internal Controls team based in Ahmedabad (India), including coordinating test status, review of controls testing work-papers and other key deliverables prepared by the Ahmedabad team.

  • Coordinate with the GBS (Global Business Services) Risk Manager to effectively execute the testing program and other key activities across controls performed by our service delivery partner.
  • Coordinate with Internal and External Audit review of processes and financial controls.
  • Support Continuous Controls Monitoring and advanced compliance and risk analytics tools like Optro Analytics and SAP Signavio.
  • Develop, maintain and coordinate the roll-out of local financial policies and procedures to the business including developing guidance and training.
  • Deliver financial controls training and coaching to upskill management and broader business stakeholders on internal controls requirements, control ownership, and effective remediation practices.
  • Provide support for strategic initiatives, system implementations, finance transformation, ad-hoc investigations and other cross-functional projects.

title: Software Development Engineer, STRADA
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Service Transformation and Deployment Automation team aims to remove all manual touchpoints from service operations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Networking, one of the world's largest and most complex networks. Software Development Engineers are instrumental in discovering innovative ways to automate and scale services. They drive stability, consistency, and sustainability of the network while never losing sight of the high security bar our customer's demand. We own a container compute platform in the border network, network device access and locality software, and a business intelligence platform for providing insights into service maturity. This position is located in Minneapolis, USA and working in the heart of AWS global network.

Millions of customers rely on Amazon's network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles, and building applications and businesses on top of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud. Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world - achieving this goal requires automated and massively scalable software services. Success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our automation.

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue twice.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for the design, implementation and quality of services you deliver. Your experience working in software development or in an enterprise environment will help us implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.
You'll also:
• Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
• Write high quality distributed system software.
• Work in an agile, startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most important stuff.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast and smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Use data to measure success and take responsibility for the quality of your service and, regardless of their source, strive to prevent faults from impacting your customers.
• Use your strong problem-solving skills, ability to understand and scope solutions, work across teams to drive solutions.
• Contribute to documentation of process and procedures.
• Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best.
• Take ownership, consider tradeoffs and lean on your expertise to ensure the job gets done.
• Participate in an on-call rotation with your team.

A day in the life
Engineers in the Backbone Enterprise and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization have a wide range
of responsibilities; we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next-generation platforms along with the tooling ecosystems to support these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint allowing our engineers to develop solutions to complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that
look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and
reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of
traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact
to our customers during events.
In this role you:
• Work in a 24x7 team on-call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.

About the team
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is
responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure
that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations.
BERE provides the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a
network that experiences 70% growth annually. In addition, they have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and Data Center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers.

AWS Global Connectivity and Network Availability (GCNA) Videos:
• Working at AWS in the GCNA Team - Meet Robert, VP:
• Working at AWS in the GCNA Team - Meet Xiaonan, Sr. Systems Development Engineer:

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Research Fellow (Organic Chemistry)
description:
The School of Chemistry, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology (CCEB) conducts interdisciplinary education and research across chemistry, chemical engineering and biotechnology, with research strengths that include synthetic, biological and medicinal chemistry.


We are looking for a Research Fellow in Organic Chemistry to develop sustainable synthetic methods for high-value glycosides through traceless activation and radical coupling. The role will focus on selective modification of carbohydrates and glycosides, radical reaction development, synthesis and purification of complex products, mechanistic studies and rigorous analytical characterization under the project “Sustainable Chemistry for High-Value Glycoside Products via Traceless Activation.”

  • Design and execute multi-step syntheses of carbohydrates, glycosides, glycomimetics and related high-value products.
  • Develop selective sugar-modification and functionalization methods using traceless activation strategies.
  • Develop and optimize radical coupling reactions, including reaction design, selectivity, efficiency and substrate-scope evaluation.
  • Plan protecting-group strategies and control chemoselectivity, regioselectivity and stereoselectivity in complex carbohydrate substrates.
  • Purify products and intermediates using flash chromatography, preparative HPLC, recrystallization and other suitable methods.

Job Requirements:

  • PhD in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Chemical Biology, Biochemistry or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience in carbohydrate chemistry, sugar modification, and the synthesis of glycosides, glycomimetics or related compounds.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and optimizing radical coupling reactions, including photochemical or electrochemical approaches where applicable.
  • Strong organic synthesis and reaction-development skills, including protecting-group strategies and control of chemoselectivity, regioselectivity and stereoselectivity.
  • Proficiency in product purification and structure characterization using flash chromatography, preparative HPLC, 1D/2D NMR, LC-MS/HRMS and HPLC/UPLC.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Synthetic Data) London, United Kingdom
description:
About us Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The role Simulation is advancing end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages — generative world models and the synthetic data they produce are one of those.

The goal of this role is to build, scale, and optimise next-generation world model architectures (GAIA and successors) and bridge them into high-throughput generation and training infrastructure, so synthetic data can dramatically accelerate autonomy development.

You will post-train world models for new embodiments and behaviours (rig transfer, pose transfer, dashcam restaging), generate multimodal synthetic experience at scale, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving. You sit between ML research and engineering: collaborating with scientists on architecture and conditioning, and with platform engineers on generation jobs, training artefacts, and how synthetic data is mixed into training.

Your work will decide how fast we can train, evaluate, and deploy driving models on vehicles we have barely collected from.

Key responsibilities:

Post-train and iterate GAIA-class world models for synthetic-data capabilities: rig transfer (new camera/vehicle embodiments), pose transfer (rewritten ego trajectories), and related conditioning (geometry, calibration, actions).

Own the generation loop: config → large-scale GPU inference → training-ready artefacts, with clear lineage from the model and settings that produced them.

Land synthetic data in driving-model training (behaviour cloning, reward models, RL): binarisation, mix ratios, quality filters, and experiments that measure suite and on-road impact — including when synthetic should replace scarce real rig data.

Diagnose and fix geometry, calibration, and controllability failures (intrinsics/extrinsics, NVS warps, odometry/curvature, flickering, camera-layout artefacts) that determine whether generated video is training-grade.

Improve throughput and yield: inference optimisations (shortcut, distillation, KV cache, step count), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist.

Expand coverage to new vehicle platforms and safety-critical scenarios (OEM bring-up; Emergency Lane Keeping / Automatic Emergency Braking).

Partner with world-model researchers, infra, and driving-model owners so generation, evaluation, and training stay one system.

About you To set you up for success as a MLE at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience:

4+ years in applied ML / research engineering, with a track record of training and shipping neural nets, not only operating data platforms.

Strong Python and PyTorch (or equivalent); comfort with GPU training, debugging, and reading model code.

Hands-on experience with video, generative, or world models (diffusion / flow-matching / autoregressive video, novel-view synthesis, neural rendering, or similar).

Working knowledge of cameras and 3D geometry (multi-camera rigs, intrinsics/extrinsics, warps/reprojection) and why they break generation or downstream training.

Evidence of taking generated or simulated data into a trained downstream model and measuring impact (mix, ablations, failure analysis).

Ability to operate generation or training at real scale (multi-GPU jobs, workflow orchestration, large video artefacts) and to make that path reliable.

Collaborative, experimental working style with researchers and platform engineers; you will own a capability, not a ticket queue.

Desirable

World models, video diffusion/flow, or controllable generation (action, pose, camera, text).

Distillation, few-step sampling, KV caching, or other inference-speed work on large generative models.

AV / robotics / simulation; multi-sensor driving data (video, telemetry; LiDAR a plus).

Productionising research: Flyte/Ray/Spark-style jobs, dataset lineage, training mix configuration.

Reward models, offline RL, or closed-loop evaluation of driving policies.

Cloud GPU fleets (Azure/AWS/GCP) and distributed training.

Why Join Us

Shape autonomy through generative simulation. Your models and data will decide whether we can train a new vehicle before the fleet exists.

Work at the frontier of world models. GAIA-scale video generation, camera transfer, pose control, and the training stack that consumes it — with the compute and fleet data to match.

Close the loop to the road. This is not synthetic data for slides. Generated experience already feeds models we take on the road; you will extend that to the next platforms and features.

High-trust, high-autonomy team. You will work with the people who built rig transfer and the generation stack — and be expected to own the next capability.

This is a full-time role based in our office in London. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. We operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

title: Developer (Full Stack), Senior
description:
About Mission Perform

Mission Perform is a performance-driven consulting, AI, and software development that partners with organizations, by building winning cultures that elevate both organizational and individual results. We are dedicated to improving how teams work, communicate, and achieve goals. We believe in “Performance Through People, Systems & Technology”.

About Mission Perform

Mission Perform is a performance-driven consulting, AI, and software development that partners with organizations, by building winning cultures that elevate both organizational and individual results. We are dedicated to improving how teams work, communicate, and achieve goals. We believe in “Performance Through People, Systems & Technology”.

We don't just advise from the sidelines: our consultants, engineers, and execs work directly alongside client teams to design, build, and ship real solutions our clients depend on.

We're a startup at heart and about to scale: lean team, fast decisions, high ownership, and direct exposure to the people who use what you build (clients, consultants, and executives), not layers of process between you and the impact of your work.

Details

This position follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of in-office attendance three days each week. The expected compensation range for this position is posted below and is based on experience, skills, and qualifications. The upper end of this range is reserved for exceptional, top-tier candidates. We use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to assist in the evaluation of applications. We may conduct background checks for successful candidates.

What's In It For You

  • Direct impact: your architectural decisions and code ship to real users solving real business problems, not stuck in a backlog behind bureaucracy.
  • Direct access: regular, unfiltered collaboration with senior consultants, executives, and clients. You'll help shape technical strategy, not just receive tickets.
  • Ownership: significant influence over architecture, technical direction, and engineering practices on a growing product, with room to grow your scope as we grow.
  • Variety: exposure to consulting-driven, client-facing work in addition to product engineering, offering a broader experience than a typical single-product engineering role.
  • A startup pace: agility, autonomy, and the chance to make a visible mark rather than being one voice among hundreds.

What You'll Do

  • Own the design and delivery of complex full stack features of our React Native + MERN stack mobile and web applications, from data model and architecture through to polished UI, exercising sound technical judgment with minimal oversight.
  • Work directly with consultants, executives, and client stakeholders to shape technical solutions to real operational problems, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Set technical direction and raise the bar on code quality by leading design/code reviews, mentoring intermediate and junior developers, and championing best practices across the codebase.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance bottlenecks, production issues, and architectural risks before they impact users, balancing shipping speed with long-term maintainability.
  • Move fast and adapt. Startup environment means your role will stretch beyond a narrow job description, and everyone's contribution is visible.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Web Developer, with deep, hands-on production experience in the MERN stack .
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Expert working knowledge in JavaScript, React (including Redux or Redux Toolkit for state management), and modern front-end practices for building and scaling large applications.
  • Expert working knowledge with Node.js and Express, including designing and building RESTful APIs and service architecture.
  • Expert working knowledge with MongoDB and an ODM such as Mongoose (schema design, query optimization, indexing) at scale.
  • Expert working knowledge writing and championing unit, integration (e.g. Jest, Testing Library, or similar), and UI tests (e.g. Selenium, Playwright, or similar).
  • Strong track record with Git-based version control and collaborative workflows (branching, pull requests, code review), including setting review standards for a team.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Strong working knowledge using AI tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate development, review code, and improve team productivity.
  • Strong working knowledge with Redis, caching strategies, or session/state management at scale.
  • Strong experience mentoring other developers and influencing technical direction or architecture decisions.
  • Experience in an Agile (Scrum / Kanban) development environment, including helping shape process for a team.
  • Familiar with Mobile development using React Native.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable speaking directly with consultants, executives, and clients.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud provider (Azure, GCP), including infrastructure/architecture decisions.
  • Experience with real-time features using Socket.IO or similar WebSocket technology.
  • Experience with UI component libraries (e.g. RSuite, Material UI, or similar) and charting/visualization libraries (e.g. Chart.js, D3.js).
  • Experience integrating third-party or AI APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic) into production applications.
  • Experience owning or building CI/CD pipelines and build tooling.
  • Prior experience in a startup, consulting, or client-facing environment.
  • Familiarity with continuous improvement frameworks such as Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Process Improvement (CPI), Business Process Management (BPM), Operational Excellence (OpEx).
  • Prior experience as a technical lead, or interest in growing into a formal technical leadership role.

How You'll Succeed

  • You write clean, maintainable code and hold your team to the same standard through thoughtful code review.
  • You take ownership of architecture and features from design through deployment and production support.
  • You balance shipping speed with code quality and long-term architectural soundness.

Benefits

title: QC Inspector
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for conducting in-process and final quality inspections of manufactured products to ensure compliance with drawings, specifications, workmanship standards, and customer requirements. The role performs inspections and quality audits throughout the manufacturing process, identifies and reports non-conformances, maintains inspection records, and supports corrective and continuous improvement activities. The position also performs final product inspection and photo documentation prior to product release.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform in-process inspections at designated stages of manufacturing to ensure products meet specified quality requirements.
  • Perform final QC inspections of finished products prior to release or shipment.
  • Conduct quality audits and inspections based on approved drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection criteria.
  • Verify product dimensions, workmanship, appearance, labeling, and other applicable quality requirements.
  • Perform and document inspection results accurately and timely.
  • Take and maintain photo documentation of finished products and identified quality issues where required.
  • Identify, document, and report non-conforming products or processes and support appropriate containment actions.
  • Work closely with Production and other relevant functions to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence.
  • Verify that corrective actions have been implemented and are effective where applicable.
  • Maintain inspection records, reports, and other quality documentation for traceability and audit purposes.
  • Support internal, customer, and external quality audits as required.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable quality standards, procedures, work instructions, and customer requirements.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives to improve product quality and reduce defects.

Job Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical qualification or relevant certification is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in QC inspection, quality control, manufacturing, or a related environment.

title: Full Stack Engineer - 3D Visualization
description:

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Department Digital & Technology Office

Employee type Regular

Cebu Pacific is always up for new challenges, enabling our teams to stay at the forefront of agile and technological innovations. Pursuing a career under Information Technology at Cebu Pacific will enable you to play a pivotal role in shaping and securing the airline’s digital landscape from business analytics, system architecture, technology engineering, project management, cybersecurity, and cloud solutions. At Cebu Pacific, we build more than just technology—we create solutions that fuel the future of travel.

Bring your technical expertise to the team and be a moment maker in the ever evolving field of Information Technology as an Analytics Engineer.

The Analytics Engineer (Data Domain Architect) is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining enterprise data products that support analytics, reporting, self-service BI, and AI initiatives across Cebu Pacific. The role translates business requirements provided by Data Product Managers into trusted, scalable, and reusable data products through conceptual, logical, dimensional, and semantic data modeling. The Analytics Engineer owns domain data models, business definitions, semantic layers, metadata, lineage requirements, and analytics-ready datasets. Working closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Governance, and business stakeholders, the Analytics Engineer ensures that data products are governed, documented, high quality, and aligned with enterprise standards and industry models. The Analytics Engineer is accountable for how data products are designed and built, ensuring they can be effectively reused across analytics, operational reporting, and AI use cases.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Modeling & Domain Architecture

  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical, dimensional, and semantic data models for assigned business domains.
  • Develop scalable and reusable domain architectures that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
  • Translate business requirements into data structures, entity relationships, hierarchies, and business rules.
  • Align data models with enterprise architecture standards and industry frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency of business definitions and domain structures across data products.

Semantic Layer & Metrics Management

  • Design and maintain enterprise semantic models, metric layers, and reusable KPI frameworks.
  • Define calculations, measures, hierarchies, and business logic supporting analytical consumption.
  • Ensure consistent implementation of business definitions across reports, dashboards, and AI solutions.
  • Manage semantic model documentation, versioning, and certification processes.

Data Product Engineering

  • Design and build analytics-ready data products for self-service analytics, reporting, and AI consumption.
  • Define reusable transformations, aggregations, and analytical structures.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure physical implementations align with business and semantic requirements.
  • Support the development of certified enterprise datasets and reusable data assets.
  • Drive reuse and standardization across multiple domains and use cases.

Metadata, Lineage & Documentation

  • Maintain business and technical metadata for assigned data products.
  • Define and document data product lineage and traceability requirements.
  • Ensure data products are cataloged, documented, and discoverable.
  • Support impact assessments and change management for data model modifications.
  • Maintain data product documentation and data dictionaries.

Data Quality by Design

  • Define quality requirements, validation rules, and business controls within data products.
  • Collaborate with Data Governance and Data Quality teams to implement quality standards.
  • Support root cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues.
  • Ensure consistency, completeness, and accuracy of certification-ready datasets.

AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement

  • Design datasets suitable for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics applications.
  • Partner with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to ensure feature consistency and data reuse.
  • Support development of governed and reusable AI-ready data products.

Promote common analytical structures and enterprise-wide reuse of trusted data assets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Preferred: Professional certifications in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Cloud Platforms, Data Management, or Enterprise Architecture (Microsoft, AWS, Azure, GCP, DAMA, TOGAF).
  • Preferred: Formal training in Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Analytics Engineering, Data Governance, or Metadata Management.

Technical & Data Skills

  • Strong knowledge of data modeling, including conceptual, logical, dimensional, and semantic modeling techniques.
  • Experience designing and managing enterprise data products, business metrics, and semantic layers.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data analysis techniques for data validation, profiling, and analytical problem-solving.
  • Experience with metadata management, data cataloging, data lineage, and data quality practices.
  • Knowledge of modern analytics platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related cloud data technologies.
  • Familiarity with data governance, enterprise data standards, and information architecture principles.
  • Preferred: Experience with Python for data analysis, data transformation, automation, analytics engineering, and AI/ML enablement.

Business & Functional Skills

  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, reusable, and analytics-ready data products.
  • Strong understanding of business processes, KPI frameworks, and decision-support requirements.
  • Experience in data product development, documentation, and knowledge management.
  • Ability to balance business needs, technical constraints, and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

Communication & Collaboration Skills

  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong facilitation, documentation, and requirements interpretation capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively with Data Product Managers, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Governance teams, and business stakeholders.

Leadership Competencies

  • Ownership and accountability for data product quality and delivery outcomes.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and consistency.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on standardization, reuse, and operational excellence.
  • Learning agility and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, and influence across teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us

  • We are the first Great Place to Work certified airline in Southeast Asia.
  • We have been recognized as Best Employer Brand on LinkedIn for two consecutive years.
  • Be part of a forward-thinking team that values innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Play a key role in developing and nurturing the talents that drive our success.
  • Accelerate your career with access to extensive learning programs and leadership development initiatives, all under Ceb U, our corporate university.
  • Enjoy unique employee perks such as free travel for you and your family. Expanded coverage to common law partners and same sex partners!
  • Be assured of a comprehensive healthcare coverage upon hire.

Note: This position is for an Individual Contributor and will be based in Pasay City, Metro Manila but currently follows a hybrid workplace flexibility arrangement.

Your moment matters. Be a Moment Maker!

Experience Range (Years)

2 - 5 years

10. Ability to be proactive, take initiative and exercise good judgment; must possess a high level of professionalism and be comfortable addressing, anticipating, and troubleshooting issues as needed.

Physical Requirements:

3. The individual may work in a standing position for extended periods of time.
4. Must have a full range of movement and be able to bend, kneel, reach overhead/below, stoop, and stand/walk for extended periods of time.
5. Will be working outdoors and inside with fluctuations in temperature and conditions.
6. May be exposed to dust, pollen, and other particulates, and should be able to work effectively under these conditions.

title: State Project Coordinator
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

1. Organizational Context:

UNDP has been working in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development. Together with the Government of India and development partners, we have worked towards eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, strengthening local governance, enhancing community resilience, protecting the environment, supporting policy initiatives and institutional reforms, and accelerating sustainable development for all.
With projects and programmes in every state and union territory in India, UNDP works with national and subnational government, and diverse development actors to deliver people-centric results, particularly for the most vulnerable and marginalized communities. As the integrator for collective action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the UN system, we are committed to supporting the Government of India’s national development vision and priorities and accelerating the achievement of the SDGs for the people and the planet.
UNDP India’s new Country Programme (2023-2027) builds on our prior work and aims to provide an integrated approach to development solutions in three strategic portfolios:
• Strong, accountable and evidence-led institutions for accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
• Enhanced economic opportunities and social protection to reduce inequality, with a focus on the marginalized.
• Climate-smart solutions, sustainable ecosystems and resilient development for reduced vulnerability.
South-South cooperation, gender equality and social inclusion are promoted across the pillars. The programme is supported by a framework of renewed partnerships and blended finance solutions, strategic innovation and accelerator labs, and data and digital architecture.

You are invited to join a team of future-smart development professionals to support India in achieving the national and globally agreed goals. As part of the UNDP team, your focus will be to work with diverse stakeholders to find country-specific solutions that lead to sustainable development and reach those furthest behind first.

2. Office/Unit/Project Description

The Action for Climate and Environment (ACE) Unit at UNDP is organized around the thematic areas of climate change adaptation and mitigation, natural resource management, biodiversity conservation, ecosystem & land restoration, disaster management and resilience, and access to clean and efficient energy.
The Natural Resource Management and Biodiversity pillar of ACE is supporting the Government of India in meeting national development objectives along with commitments under important multilateral environment agreements especially the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD). The programme/projects under the pillar have been supporting the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEFCC), National and State level planning for land restoration and biodiversity conservation, habitat restoration, carbon sequestration through enhanced restoration, promotion of nature-based livelihoods and One Health approach.
UNDP is supporting the Ministry in the implementation of a GEF -7 project “Sustainable management and restoration of degraded landscapes for achieving Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) in India”. The project aims to achieve land degradation neutrality by creating additional carbon sinks through an ecosystem-based approach for restoring degraded agricultural, forest, pastoral lands, and surface water bodies. It involves enabling institutional frameworks and policies for integrated sustainable land management practices and up-scaling landscape-wide practices in 3 states Gujarat, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh contributing to the national target of restoring 26 Mha of degraded lands by 2030.
The project being implemented over a period of five years will lead to the following outcomes: (1) Enhanced national, state and district-level enabling frameworks incentivizing SLM practices and supporting participatory multi-sector platforms to avoid, reduce and reverse land degradation, biodiversity loss and climate mitigation; (2) Integrated participatory landscape design and financing models established in support of avoidance, reduction and reversal of land degradation, desertification, biodiversity loss and negative impacts of climate change to generates multiple sustained environmental and economic benefits; (3) Improved capacity for LDN monitoring, assessment and reporting to UNCCD in support of LDN target setting and evaluation of capacities of partners; allowing government institutions and other agencies to better document, analyse and disseminate effective intervention strategies for restoring productive landscapes and replication of best practices at national and state level, and at international level through improved South-South cooperation, knowledge and adaptive management.
UNDP seeks to engage a State Project Coordinator who will support the National Project Manager (NPM) in the implementation of the GEF-GoI-UNDP LDN project. S/he will also work closely with the NPMU, SPMU, LPMU and UNDP in the implementation of the project in the state. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic, motivated, and committed to making a positive contribution to development in India.

3. Job Purpose and Scope of Work

Main Purpose:

The State Project Coordinator will work under the supervision and guidance of the National Project Manager (NPM), NPMU and State Project Management Unit (SPMU). S/he will work closely with National Project Management Unit (NPMU) and Landscape Project Management Unite (LPMU) in the implementation of the project in the project state. S/he will have the following responsibilities:

Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Project Planning, Management and Implementation including support on Monitoring and Evaluation
• Support / Assist in planning, coordination, implementation and monitoring of the project to ensure that its results are in accordance with the project document and project results framework in the state.
• Assume full responsibility of project management on a daily basis in the state – budgeting, ensure adequate information flow, discussion and feedback among relevant stakeholders of the project.
• Develop state specific annual work plans and ensure accurate and timely reporting to MoEFCC and UNDP for activities of the project in the state.
• Guide the team at the landscape level and monitor the work undertaken by consultants employed under the project.
• Assist the NPMU/SPMU/UNDP in independent Mid-term and Terminal Evaluation of the project.

2. Stakeholder Coordination, Partnerships and Convergence and Resource Movilization
• Ensure regular communication and coordination with the National Project Management Unit, State Project Steering Committee, Landscape Level Committee and Management Unit, UNDP and MoEFCC with respect to project activities in the state.
• Foster partnerships with relevant line departments and technical institutions working on land and forest management and sustainable livelihood to bring convergence in the project.
• Organize, facilitate and participate in the periodic review meetings including State Project Steering Committee and State Technical Committee meetings at least once or twice, per year, subject to availability of members and follow up on decisions taken at such meetings.
• Coordinate with other state departments to ensure convergence and sharing knowledge and best practices learnt in the project landscapes for scale up and replication.
• Coordinate with NPMU and LPMU under the project to share lessons and experiences.
• Develop proposals for resource mobilization to augment support to the programme/project.

3. Procurement, Contract and Operational Management
• Develop Terms of Reference for hiring / engagements of consultants/ institutions/consultancy firms to be hired to undertake project activities and help the state government/UNDP in contracting processes.
• Commission activities including research studies, state level assessments, conduct and impart training / workshops etc. and manage the operational aspects of procurement, event management, logistics etc. in coordination with the state nodal officer and UNDP.
• Manage and track contracts with project partners and flag any potential risks and suggest its mitigation measures. Ensure timely contract management and payments.
• Review quality and consistency of reports and deliverables by partner institutions/ responsible parties including financial reports from all project partners.

4. Financial Management and Reporting

• Track and manage project expenditure in the state in accordance with the budget, financial rules and procedures of the State, MoEFCC and UNDP to ensure transparency, responsibility and timely achievement of project targets.
• Develop and ensure timely submission of Quarterly Progress Reports, Annual Progress Reports, Project Implementation Report and mid-term progress reports to NPMU and UNDP, based on inputs from the landscape and state.

5. Knowledge Management, Learning and Documentation
• Help in identification and documentation of best practices across thematic areas relevant to the project.
• Coordinate with NPMU and LPMU under the project to share lessons and experiences.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

4. Institutional Arrangement

Reporting To: National Project Manager (NPM), NPSA 10
Repotees to this position (if applicable): Landscape Project Officer (3 positions)- UNV, Community Mobilizer- UNV.

5. Competencies:

Core:

Achieve Results: LEVEL 2: Scale up solutions and simplify processes, balance speed and accuracy in doing work

Think Innovatively: LEVEL 2: Offer new ideas/ is open to new approaches, demonstrate systemic/integrated thinking

Learn Continuously: LEVEL 2: Go outside comfort zone, learn from others, and support their learning

Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 2: Adapt processes/approaches to new situations, involve others in change process

Act with Determination: LEVEL 2: Able to persevere and deal with multiple sources of pressure simultaneously

Engage and Partner: LEVEL 2: Is facilitator/integrator, bring people together, build/maintain coalitions/ partnerships

Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making

People Management Competencies:
UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site. (PeopleManagementCompetencies.pdf)

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies:

Thematic Area: Business Direction and Strategy

Name: Strategic Thinking

Definition: Develop effective strategies and prioritised plans in line with UNDP’s mission and objectives, based on the systemic analysis of challenges, opportunities and potential risks; link the general vision to reality on the ground to create tangible targeted solutions; learn from a variety of sources to anticipate and effectively respond to both current and future trends; demonstrate foresight.

Thematic Area: Business Management

Name: Project Management

Definition: Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goals

Thematic Area: Business Management

Name: Risk Management

Definition: Identify and organize action around reducing, mitigating and proactively managing risks.

Thematic Area: 2030 Agenda: Planet

Name: Nature

Definition: Ecosystems and Biodiversity: Natural Resource Management

6. Minimum Qualifications of the Successful NPSA

Min. Education requirements:

• Secondary education is required.
• A university degree (bachelor´s degree) in Environmental Science/Forestry/ Agriculture/ Sustainable Development/ Social Sciences/ Public Policy/ Management or equivalent field will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.

7. Min. years of relevant work experience:

• Minimum of 7 years (with secondary education) or 4 years (with bachelor’s degree) of relevant experience in natural resource management, biodiversity conservation, social development, or any other related fields.

8. Required skills:

• Demonstrated technical experience in sustainable land management and socio-economic development, with experience coordinating with government agencies, stakeholders, and Project Management Units (PMUs).
• Experience in preparing technical reports, strategic plans, and progress updates for government and other key stakeholders.

9. Desired skills in addition to the competencies covered in the Competencies section:

• Demonstrated experience in leading technical teams and facilitating consultations with government stakeholders to support project implementation, monitoring and evaluation, coordination, and achievement of project objectives and targets.
• Hands-on technical experience in the implementation and monitoring of development, environmental, or natural resource management projects.
• Experience working with Central and/or State Government departments, UN agencies, international organizations, or similar institutions, including coordination with government,

10. Required Language(s):

• Fluency in English and Hindi or Marathi is required.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization.
