title: R-00192196 Senior Inventory Specialist/Logistician TS/SCI Poly
description:
Leidos has a new and exciting opportunity for a Senior Inventory Specialist/Logistician in our Intel Sector's Cyber & Analytics Business Area (CABA). Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos, we offer competitive benefits, including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more. Join us and make a difference in National Security!


A self-motivated Senior Inventory Specialist/Logistician is needed to support a large, complex, fast-paced program operating within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). The program provides systems engineering, development, test, integration, and operational support for a mission-focused system that is continuously incorporating new technology and advanced capabilities while sustaining ongoing mission and operational requirements.


The selected candidate will be responsible for managing hardware, software, and service procurements for a large and complex system consisting of geographically distributed nodes and diverse configurations across a multifaceted network environment. The individual will create and maintain required documentation, and will work closely with Infrastructure Teams, System Test, System Administration, Integration Engineers, and Software Engineers to identify procurement requirements and will track hardware and software status across the program.


Primary Responsibilities

The selected candidate will support the procurement of software licenses and hardware assets throughout the full procurement lifecycle, from requisition through delivery and closeout. The individual will track hardware warranties and software maintenance periods to help prevent any lapse in coverage or support. The selected candidate will monitor multiple ticket queues and respond to requests within established timelines. She/he will support multiple Technical Task Orders, update related Bills of Material, and work with program team members to streamline material procurement in support of program requirements. The selected candidate will also track material movement through the procurement process, resolve issues affecting progress, and work with buyers and material planners to prioritize urgent requests and coordinate timely delivery. In addition, the selected candidate will maintain hardware inventory reports and databases.


Basic Qualifications

  • BA degree and 12 – 15 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 10 – 13 years of prior relevant experience. Additional experience may be substituted for a degree.
  • At least 8 years of experience managing IT hardware, and software.
  • At least 5 years of experience handling purchase requisitions.
  • At least 3 years of experience with Bills of Material (BOMs).
  • Proficiency with Excel spreadsheets, including formulas.
  • Experience researching parts and technical configurations based on engineering specifications.
  • Experience working with engineers, control account managers, material planners, and buyers to develop, request, and review quotes.
  • Experience with hardware and software warranties, maintenance, and support.
  • Experience with software licensing models, including subscriptions and term licenses.
  • Experience researching and creating RMAs (Return Material Authorizations) using prior purchase information such as serial numbers, government barcodes, model numbers, and purchase dates.
  • Must have the ability to lift up to 45 pounds of equipment, with or without the use of an aid.
  • Must be willing to conduct local travel several times per week within a 20-mile radius, as well as approximately 1-2 CONUS trips annually to conduct hardware inventories at program facilities throughout the United States. CONUS travel is expected to range from 3 to 5 days per trip.
  • Clearance Required: Must have TS/SCI with Polygraph.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing multiple purchases simultaneously across various stages of the procurement process, including partial receipts, backorders, goods receipts, data transfers, BOM updates, purchase closeouts, and delivery tracking.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • System administration experience and/or hands-on experience with hardware and software maintenance.
  • Experience working as a Quality Control/Quality Assurance Specialist, Configuration Management Analyst, or Auditing Professional, particularly on a large system.

title: Associate, Recruiting
description:
About this role

This hire will be part of the APAC Talent Acquisition Team, which is spread across Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan and India. They will be responsible for running end to end recruitment searches while ensuring all recruitment processes are adhered to for the business unit aligned. Knowledge/ Experience Required:

  • The ideal candidate should have at least 7+ yrs of experience in Talent Acquisition having handled complex tech roles. Exposure to APAC recruiting a plus.
  • Experience with volume recruiting is strongly preferred.
  • Thorough understanding of hiring in domains like Technology, Asset Management & Analytics is a must have.
  • Experience of independently managing business unit hiring with high volumes
  • Experience of working in a complex/matrix business structure is a pre-requisite for the role.
  • Exposure to various search practices and techniques– including the ability to approach candidates directly and provide ad-hoc mapping and market intelligence.
  • Advanced knowledge and experience of candidate closing skills/techniques.
  • Experience of setting and communicating strategy, and a track record of delivering results.
  • The ability to consult with and influence senior management.

Competencies:

  • Superior influencing, stakeholder and relationship management skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • A strong team ethic is key.
  • A strong team player.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high results.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

description:

Transport freight across dock area to/from trailers for loading to trailers.

  • Build and support high-availability, backup, DR and business continuity solutions.
  • Conduct incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, and performance tuning activities for production environments.
  • Support sustainable operations by developing automated responses for routine service conditions and scaling systems efficiently through automation.
  • Collaborate closely with application development, architecture, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient and scalable solutions.
  • Participate in system design reviews, cloud resource planning(capacity planning), launch readiness assessments, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Create and maintain user documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Mentor junior engineers and define engineering standard processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain scripts, tools, and software components using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or other programming languages to support platform operations.

Required Skills & Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Compute Services Azure Storage Azure Networking Azure Security & Governance
  • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates)

  • PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash scripting
  • Windows and Linux system administration
  • Monitoring, Logging, and End-to-End Observability Capabilities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, Software Engineering, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, and reliability engineering principles.
  • Experience in software development and automation using one or more programming languages is an advantage.

Experience Required

  • 7-10 years of overall IT Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering experience.
  • Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience handling and supporting large-scale production environments and critical applications.
  • Proven expertise in automation, infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, fixing.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work optimally in multi-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400, or equivalent.
  • Experience with containerization, Kubernetes operations, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Knowledge of reliability engineering, observability, and platform engineering standard methodologies.

title: Director, AI & CX Services
description:
Director, AI & CX Services
Customer Experience & AI Enablement

Company Overview

Waterfield Tech enables companies to select, design, and deploy tailored customer engagement solutions from the world’s leading providers enhanced by cutting edge Applied AI. The results are happier customers, enhanced insights, and lower costs.

Once live, we empower companies to support, optimize, and modernize those solutions and AI applications, leading to lower risk and increased efficiency. Our client-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction.

We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls.

Position Summary

Waterfield Tech is seeking a Director, AI & CX Services to lead and grow one or more professional services delivery practices that design, implement, and modernize customer experience and contact center solutions across leading CCaaS and UC platforms and our Applied AI capabilities. The Director owns the full P&L for the practices held and is accountable for delivery outcomes, quality, growth, and the people in each practice.

Bringing deep, hands-on delivery expertise, the Director sets the delivery approach, standards, and CX modernization roadmap for the practices held, is the senior escalation and executive point of contact for customers, owns the manufacturer/partner relationships, and partners across Sales, Product, and Operations. The role leads the technical leads and engineers who deliver the practices, including any custom development/Applied AI that extends the platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead one or more AI & CX Services delivery practices end to end, accountable for delivery outcomes, quality, utilization, and margin across the practices held.
  • Own the full P&L for the practices held (revenue, margin, cost structure, headcount investment, and partner tier economics) and own the capacity to pipeline strategy and the investment that closes the gap.
  • Set and communicate the delivery strategy and CX modernization roadmap for the practices held: secure senior leadership buy-in and resources; monitor industry trends, partner roadmaps, and customer feedback; and lead organizational change (change management plans for new methodologies, technologies, and operating models) that fosters continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Lead and develop the teams within the practices held: hire, coach, develop, and retain leaders and individual contributors; set goals, run performance and career development, and build leadership depth and succession.
  • Grow the delivery capability and own the manufacturer/partner relationships for the practices held, including certifications, enablement, partner tier, roadmap alignment, and joint delivery.
  • Establish portfolio level delivery governance and roadmap and release management standards for the practices held, including cadence, health reporting, KPIs, risk and escalation management, quality gates, release readiness, and the accelerator/IP release pipeline; report progress and outcomes to senior leadership.
  • Set and own delivery standards, methodology, reference architectures, accelerators, templates, quality bars, and the implementation to support handoff and lifecycle standards for the practices held (flows/IVR, IVA/agent assist, WFO/WEM, reporting/administration, and CRM/CTI integrations); run post-mortems and lessons learned, and feed delivery insight into renewals and expansions.
  • Own resource and capacity planning across the practices held; partner with Sales on scoping, feasibility, and level of effort while protecting margin during pre-sales.
  • Serve as the senior escalation and executive point of contact for customers across the practices held; maintain executive relationships, satisfaction, and reference-ability.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, IT, Operations, and commercial, pre-sales, and proposal colleagues, bridging technical and non-technical teams to drive aligned execution of CX modernization.
  • Drive AI enablement in both directions: delivering AI solutions to customers and applying AI to delivery operations (portfolio health signals, status roll-ups, risk analysis, documentation) across the practices held.
  • Where a custom development/Applied AI capability is held, own the team that builds integrations, APIs, conversational AI, and AI-enabled applications that extend the platforms, and align its roadmap to customer and practice needs.
  • Review the customer satisfaction and delivery results (CSAT, NPS, and KPIs) for the practices held; use that data, customer feedback, and delivery metrics to identify pain points and trends and drive data driven decisions that refine delivery and the CX strategy.
  • Ensure booking, time entry, and delivery operations within Microsoft Dynamics 365/Project Operations across the practices held.

How This Role Is Measured

  • Practice P&L & economics: Gross margin and revenue vs. plan; utilization to target; cost structure vs. plan; estimate at completion/burn variance within threshold; headcount ROI.
  • Delivery execution & quality: On time delivery and schedule variance across the practices held; reduction in escalations, rework, and margin leakage; quality gate/release readiness pass rate; estimate accuracy.
  • Customer outcomes & satisfaction: CSAT/NPS trend across the practices held; executive relationship health and reference-ability; resolution and recovery of at-risk engagements.
  • People & leadership: Team retention and engagement; certification and skills growth; leadership bench and succession depth; goal setting and performance review completion.
  • Growth & capacity: Practice expansion and revenue growth vs. plan; pipeline conversion and capacity to pipeline coverage; demand forecast accuracy.
  • Partner standing: Manufacturer certifications and partner tier maintained or improved; partner sourced pipeline and joint delivery results.
  • Strategy, standards & AI enablement: Adoption of delivery standards, methodology, and accelerators; CX modernization roadmap and change initiative milestones delivered; AI in delivery adoption and impact.
  • Operational discipline: Data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of D365 booking, time entry, and delivery operations.

Primary Delivery & Technical Experience

  • Strong Five9 practice experience required, with multiple production implementations and migrations at scale (inbound, outbound, blended, Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, WFO/WEM, Studio/IVR, reporting and VCC administration, and CRM/CTI integrations such as Salesforce and ServiceNow).
  • Zoom (Contact Center, Phone, and Workplace) and custom development/Applied AI delivery preferred.
  • All other CCaaS/UC practice areas a plus: Genesys (Cloud CX), Cisco (Webex Contact Center/UC), Avaya (Aura/AEP/ACO), and Google (Contact Center AI/Dialogflow).
  • AI enablement: Conversational AI, virtual agents, agent assist, real-time analytics, and AI-powered self-service.
  • Multi-vendor/multi-platform delivery: Combining two or more of the above with CRM, WFM, QA, and analytics integrations; legacy to cloud migration delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 12+ years delivering complex CX/contact center technology services, with 5+ years leading, building, and retaining delivery teams (people leadership) accountable for delivery outcomes and margin.
  • Grounded in hands-on delivery, with career progression through implementation consultant, technical/solutions architect, or professional services/telephony (CCaaS) engineering into delivery leadership.
  • Proven track record leading CX modernization initiatives at a leadership level.
  • Demonstrated financial and practice economics acumen: margin, utilization, burn vs. plan, and estimate at completion.
  • Experience owning manufacturer/partner relationships, including certification, enablement, and partner tier management, and leading customer executive governance and recovery of at-risk engagements.
  • Software development/Applied AI engineering leadership a plus.

Leadership Attributes

  • Executive presence and people leadership: build, coach, and retain multi-team technical organizations.
  • Strong financial and operational discipline; balances growth, margin, and headcount investment while protecting delivery quality.
  • Data driven, innovative, and future oriented; turns customer and delivery data into modern CX strategy.
  • Sets strategy and standards across diverse teams and resolves cross-team tensions constructively.
  • Outstanding communication across all levels, including C-suite and partner executives; strong change management expertise; thrives amid rapid change and ambiguity.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s a plus. Emphasis in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.

Additional Requirements

  • Manufacturer/platform certifications strongly valued across the CCaaS/UC ecosystem.
  • PMP/PgMP, ITIL, and change management credentials (e.g., Prosci ADKAR) a plus, but not required for this role.
  • Availability to work flexible hours as needed, including senior customer escalations.

Physical Requirements

  1. Sitting: Ability to sit for extended periods (up to 80% of the time).
  2. Lifting: Ability to lift or carry objects up to 10 lbs.
  3. Equipment: Frequent use of computer, telephone, and standard office equipment.
  4. Travel: Ability to travel up to 15% for client meetings, training, or installations.

All employees must be citizens of the United States or be able to provide proof of employment eligibility.

title: Defense Mission Protocol Professional
description:
Defense Mission Protocol Professional

The Opportunity:

As a defense mission professional, you ask questions others don’t. You understand the nuances of complex situations. You use your skills to think bigger and push further, solving complex problems. We’re looking for an expert like you to create solutions for missions that keep our nation safe.


As a Protocol Specialist, you’ll bring your comprehensive knowledge of protocol, courtesies, and etiquette to work on projects for a General and Flag officer level military command. You’ll research and analyze orders, directives, and policy guiding military protocols to provide advice and planning support, and coordinate recommendations ceremonies, social functions, and receptions held in honor of visiting dignitaries to ensure appropriateness of all elements of planned functions and preclude embarrassment to the command. You’ll be a trusted advisor to our clients, and we’ll look to you to identify, analyze, and evaluate complex systems, policies, and processes to achieve the protocol outcome within regulatory guidelines.


You’ll guide the work we do for our Department of Defense (DoD) client and the solutions we deliver for our military client as it relates to effective protocol analysis, planning, and coordination. You served your country in uniform, now continue your mission with us. Further your career with us as you help solve complex design, integration, and analytical problems for Defense Protocol.


Join us. The world can’t wait.


You Have:


  • 3+ years of experience working as a Protocol Officer at the General and Flag Officer level
  • Knowledge of the Marine Corps organizational structure and functions of a general officer at the Major Subordinate Command level or higher
  • Knowledge of protocol courtesies and etiquette elements for distinguished visitors such as military, civilians, U.S., and foreign visitors, including government officials, high ranking military officers, community leaders, elected officials, and corporate leaders and directives and parameters under which subordinate, adjacent, and higher organizations must operate
  • Knowledge of local community organizations and activities or special events to plan, coordinate, budget, execute, and evaluate involvement in local activities
  • Knowledge of software applications such as databases, word processing, and spreadsheets, and integrating different software applications into a single product to perform non-routine functions and advise others on methods and procedures
  • Knowledge of Official Representation Funds (ORF) and Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF)
  • Ability to work at a fast pace while supporting multiple military events at once and work complex assignments and unique and dynamic situations that require application of critical thinking and problem-solving to develop good courses of action to solve problems
  • Ability to write and verbally communicate at the level expected for a general officer command, including review, correct, originate, or prepare draft or final material in proper naval correspondence format, prepare comprehensive After-Action Reports (AARs) and critiques following major visits, ceremonies, and social functions, analyze outcomes to identify systemic improvements for future events, and work with higher Headquarters and Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) when needed to obtain ORF or manage NAF for official events
  • Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED

Nice If You Have:


  • Experience training all members of a team to perform the duties of every other member of the team
  • Knowledge of different administrative processes and procedures utilized by the major departments of a Flag-level command
  • Knowledge of military and civilian rank and grade structures and related protocol or precedence information
  • Knowledge of Marine Corps and Joint Travel Regulations (JTR) and Defense Travel System (DTS)
  • Bachelor's degree

title: Rengøringsassistent
description:
Frisk og detaljeorienteret medarbejder søges til erhvervsrengøring i dagtimerne

Vil du have et selvstændigt job med faste rammer, fysisk arbejde og en hverdag, hvor dit bidrag gør en synlig forskel? Hos AMG-Gruppen har vi travlt, og vi søger nu en stabil og grundig kollega til at overtage ansvaret for almindelig erhvervsrengøring hos nogle af vores kunder.

Stillingen er på 15–20 timer om ugen med gode muligheder for mere på længere sigt, hvis samarbejdet går godt og dette ønskes.

Dine arbejdstider

Arbejdstiden ligger primært i morgen- og dagtimerne på hverdage, hvilket giver dig gode, forudsigelige rammer og frie aftener. Derudover skal du være indstillet på at arbejde én lørdag om måneden.

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver en del af AMG-Gruppen. Vi er en solid og erfaren servicevirksomhed, der leverer rengøring i absolut topkvalitet. For os er rengøring et håndværk, og vi værdsætter vores medarbejdere højt. Vi sørger for, at du får en grundig oplæring, ordentlige forhold og alt det nødvendige udstyr, så du kan udføre dit arbejde effektivt.

Hvad skal du lave?

Dine primære opgaver bliver almindelig erhvervsrengøring af kontorlandskaber, skurvogne, lejligheder efter udflytning el. renovering, trapper, og andre erhvervslokaler.

Hvem leder vi efter?

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring inden for branchen – vi skal nok give dig den rette oplæring. Det vigtigste er din indstilling:

  • Du har gyldigt kørekort (B): Da du skal kunne komme rundt til vores kunder med rengøringsredskaber.

  • Du kommunikerer let på dansk: Du behøver ikke at kunne snakke flydende, men du skal kunne gøre dig forståelig og dermed også forstå vores kunder, når de taler dansk til dig

  • Du er detaljeorienteret og grundig: Du sætter en ære i dit arbejde og forlader altid kunden med et flot, rent og præsentabelt resultat.

  • Du er mødestabil og selvstændig: Du formår at arbejde effektivt på egen hånd og tager ansvar for dine faste opgaver.

  • Du har en positiv udstråling: Du møder vores kunder med et smil, når du har din gang i deres lokaler.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • Et selvstændigt og ansvarsfuldt job i faste rammer.

  • En uformel virksomhedskultur med plads til godt humør og gensidig respekt.

  • Grundig oplæring og professionelt udstyr.

  • Mulighed for flere timer i takt med, at virksomheden vækster.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os en ansøgning via mail, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, og hvorfor du er den rette medarbejder til jobbet. Vedhæft meget gerne dit CV.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Middle Full-Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Middle Full-Stack Engineer to join our AI & Automation Engineering team and work on our Internal Operational Platform — a growing product designed to automate workflows across multiple departments at AI Digital.

The platform is being developed as a central place where teams can access tools supporting their internal processes. The team is currently expanding its functionality, supporting existing applications, and gradually bringing more workflows from different departments onto the platform.

This is a hands-on full-stack engineering role with a strong backend and integration focus, within an established engineering stack and in close collaboration with engineers and business stakeholders as the platform continues to evolve.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain full-stack applications using Java/Spring Boot and React/TypeScript.

  • Develop new functionality for our Internal Operational Platform and support existing applications as the platform continues to expand.

  • Transform AI-generated and vibe-coded MVPs into reliable, production-ready applications while preserving the original product intent.

  • Refactor prototype logic into clean backend services, typed APIs, PostgreSQL schemas, and maintainable frontend workflows.

  • Design and implement PostgreSQL schemas and manage database migrations with Liquibase.

  • Develop REST APIs following an OpenAPI contract-first approach and work with typed frontend API clients.

  • Integrate applications with BigQuery and support reliable data publishing and integration flows.

  • Implement and maintain backend observability using Spring Boot Actuator, Prometheus metrics, and structured logging.

  • Contribute to application quality through testing, monitoring, maintenance, and production support.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and other engineers to translate real workflows into practical technical solutions.

  • Backend: Solid experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Maven, Liquibase, Spring Security, and OpenAPI-based development.

  • Frontend: Practical experience with React and TypeScript, API-driven interfaces, and server-state management such as TanStack Query.

  • Data & Integration: Experience with BigQuery or another data warehouse and integrating applications with external APIs and data sources.

  • Production Engineering: Good understanding of authentication, persistence, logging, monitoring, testing, and maintainability.

  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience with tools such as Cursor, Claude/Anthropic, OpenAI, Replit AI, or similar, including reviewing and improving AI-generated code.

  • Comfortable collaborating with both engineers and business stakeholders in an evolving product environment.

  • English level B2 or higher.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

What We Offer

  • 31 days of paid time off: 21 days of annual leave + 10 days of sick leave, because your health and work-life balance matter.

  • Private health insurance and FitPass: supporting your well-being both inside and outside of work.

  • Growth-focused environment: access to learning resources and clear pathways for growth.

  • Fun team events: virtual cooking classes, yoga sessions, team quizzes and more.

  • A culture of trust: we cut the red tape — results over rules always. Open talk, ownership, and getting things done together.

Hiring Flow

  • Screening Interview (45 minutes): initial conversation with a recruiter.

  • Technical Interview (up to 120 minutes): A deep dive into your functional expertise, problem-solving approach, and practical skills relevant to the role.

  • Final Interview (Up to 60 minutes): Meet with the Team Lead for an in-depth discussion of your experience and skills.

  • Offer: if successful, you’ll receive an offer to join our team.

Location & Eligibility

This role is open to applicants from Serbia.
Please note that we’re unable to consider applications from outside these locations.
Thanks for your understanding!

title: Analog Design Intern
description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

As an Analog IC Design Engineer with Marvell, you’ll be a member of the Central Engineering business group. If you picture Marvell as a wheel, Central Engineering is the center hub providing IP to be used by all the other spokes on that wheel, including Automotive, Storage, Security, and Networking. You’ll be part of a small analog team making a big impact on this organization. Additionally, Marvell has the perfect size and scale for you to learn several aspects of engineering that will be new to you, but also have the time and freedom to dive deep into the details of your specialization on most projects.

What You Can Expect

In this (hybrid/remote/in-office) role in LOCATION, you’ll build transistor level circuits from scratch or be given existing blocks to improve or port. Using a variety of CAD tools, but primarily Cadence, you will build or improve your circuit, simulate different performance metrics and measure other parameters. You’ll do circuit analysis and if your circuit looks good, you’ll send it to layout for physical design. Once it’s created, you get it back, run simulations and tests, and continue iterating until the circuit performs precisely as you need it to. You’ll attend weekly meetings with your team to discuss your projects at a high level. If any issues arise, the team may take a more focused look at the problem to work out a solution. You’ll also attend meetings with senior designers and managers to review your work at a detailed level. On this team, you’ll have the opportunity to see your designs go from an idea all the way through production and into use by other groups at Marvell.

What We're Looking For

Approved Intern for 2027 Calendar Year

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

38 - 76, $ per hour.

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.





Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

description:

Position Summary:

Florida Atlantic University is seeking a Career Coach, Career Pathways & Coaching - Boca Raton, FL.

The Career Coach plays a critical role in advancing students' career and economic mobility by helping them become Day One Career Ready. Through personalized coaching, career education, employer engagement, and experiential learning opportunities, this position helps students understand the value and return on investment of their FAU education. This position guides students in connecting their academic experiences to career goals, developing professional competencies, making informed career decisions, and successfully transitioning into employment, graduate education, or other post-graduate opportunities.

Summary of Responsibilities

  • Provide individualized career coaching to undergraduate students, graduate students, and alumni through virtual and in-person appointments on topics including career exploration, career pathways, major selection, internship and job search strategies, resume and cover letter development, interviewing, networking, graduate school preparation, and professional identity development.

  • Completes detailed notes of the career coaching session according to standards and follows up with students and alumni with resources at the conclusion of each appointment.

  • Support students in developing personalized career action plans that connect academic programs, co-curricular engagement, experiential learning opportunities, and career goals while helping students understand and communicate the return on investment of their education.

  • Design, implement, and facilitate workshops, classroom presentations, and career education programs focused on career readiness, professional development, industry trends, career pathways, experiential learning, and workforce preparation.

  • Administer, interpret, and utilize career assessments and evidence-based career development practices to assist students in identifying strengths, interests, values, skills, and career opportunities.

  • Collaborate with campus partners to integrate career development throughout the student experience and promote career readiness as a shared institutional responsibility.

  • Coordinate and deliver career development programming during orientation, admissions events, Family Weekend, and other university programs to educate students and families on career pathways, career readiness, experiential learning, and student success resources.

  • Develop resources and programs that help students make informed decisions regarding majors, careers, internships, graduate education, and employment opportunities while increasing awareness of career outcomes and workforce demand.

  • Teach and coordinate multiple sections of career courses, incorporating career development theory, labor market information, career readiness competencies, metacognition, decision-making skills, and career pathway exploration to support student success and retention.

  • Support employer engagement activities, including career fairs, information sessions, recruiting events, networking programs, and industry-focused initiatives that connect students with career opportunities.

  • Participate in supervision meetings, case reviews, assessment efforts, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance student outcomes and service delivery.

description:

description:
Acerca de Bridgestone

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), con sede en Nashville, Tennessee, y Bridgestone Europa, Medio Oriente y África (BSEMEA), con sede en Bruselas, Bélgica, operan colectivamente como la región estratégica “Bridgestone West”. Job Category

Information Technology

Position Summary

Servant leader and operational supervisor for two Scrum Teams, enabling predictable value delivery by leading teams thru effective ways of work, optimizing team capacity and flow, and coordinating team level risks and dependencies with peers in the Agile Release Train (ART). Ensure transparency through metrics, and enforce governance and quality practices within the team in alignment with security and compliance standards. Partner with the Product Owner to maintain backlog readiness and outcome focus, and lead the team to high performing practices, continuous improvement, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Implement team‑level delivery governance (cadences, DoR/DoD, compliance checks) aligned with ART standards.
  • Coordinate dependencies with other teams and escalate impediments beyond team control.
  • Remove impediments and guide the team in problem‑solving practices.
  • Facilitate preparation and participation in PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt, and Scrum of Scrums.
  • Monitor team capacity, track contractor hours, and allocate work to optimize flow under established guidelines.
  • Evaluate team performance through dashboards and flow metrics and provide insights to the RTE and Product Management.
  • Develop team capability by mentoring members in Agile/SAFe, facilitation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support the Product Owner in backlog refinement, readiness, and prioritization toward value outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory practices at the team level.
  • Promote adherence to quality standards and best practices within the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, business administration or equivalent work experience.
  • Scrum Master (Scrum Alliance), Professional Scrum Master (Scrum.org), or SAFe Scrum Master (ScaledAgile.com) certificate
  • Good skills and knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency.
  • Good communication and mentoring skills.
  • Experience as Scrum Master for a software development team that was diligently applying Scrum principles.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Azure DevOps (ADO) or Jira boards to drive backlog refinement prioritization, and end to end Agile delivery
  • Excellent oral and written communication
  • Ability to prioritize effectively
  • Ability to work with larger teams
  • Ability to maintain a keen attention to detail, multitask and work well under pressure
  • Natural tendency to be curious, positive and creative
  • Sincere empathy for the customer and commitment to delving deep into the challenges they present or experience

En Bridgestone, lo que realmente importa es generar oportunidades de co-creación, mientras fomentamos tu curiosidad y creatividad para hacer que la movilidad sea más segura, eficiente y sostenible para las generaciones presentes y futuras.

Cualquiera que sea el rol que desempeñes, cuando representas a Bridgestone, eres un/una integrante valioso/valiosa de equipo y parte de nuestra misión más amplia de “Servir a la Sociedad con Calidad Superior”. Te ofrecemos más que solo un pago competitivo; también te proporcionaremos:

Bridgestone se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades de empleo. Es nuestra política considerar para el empleo a todas las personas independientemente de su edad, color, origen, discapacidad física o mental, raza, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad y/o expresión de género, información genética, o cualquier otra característica protegida por las leyes federales, estatales o locales.

En Bridgestone, siempre eres Libre para Ser

Creemos que las personas solo pueden brindar un servicio y una calidad superiores a los demás cuando pueden traer su yo más auténtico al trabajo. Creemos en defender todas las perspectivas, individualidades y equipos porque entendemos la importancia de ver el mundo y nuestro negocio a través de diferentes perspectivas. title: Chief People Officer
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Why This Role Matters: An Exceptional Opportunity –

You will lead one of the most strategic functions in a thriving, growth-focused Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) services firm at a pivotal moment in its evolution.


This role sits at the intersection of talent strategy and business transformation — where your decisions directly impact the firm's ability to attract world-class talent, retain top performers, and build the leadership bench required for sustained growth and market leadership.


You will partner with an engaged, forward-thinking executive team that views People as a competitive advantage, not an afterthought. If you thrive at building scalable talent systems, transforming organizational culture, celebrating and recognizing team member contributions, and developing leaders who drive real business results, this is your opportunity to make an outsized impact on a firm with the resources, commitment, and ambition to do this work at scale.


Role Summary

We are a growing and evolving Architecture, Engineering, Construction (AEC), and Systems Integration firm seeking a strategic Chief People Officer to help drive our next phase of growth. As a key member of the executive leadership team, the CPO will develop and execute the firm's People strategy, ensuring the organization has the talent, leadership, culture, and capabilities needed to achieve its business objectives.


This leader will oversee talent acquisition, talent development, performance management, compensation, HR business partnerships, and people operations while partnering closely with business leaders to strengthen organizational effectiveness and advance a high-performance, people-centered culture. Leading a team of approximately 40 People professionals, the CPO will build scalable programs, processes, and systems that support sustainable growth and exceptional business results.

KEY RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Evolve People Team Operating Model and Structure
    • Assess capabilities of the People Team and how the team is organized and staffed to meet evolving firm needs.
    • Ensure the team has the right skills, roles, and capabilities to deliver maximum support to the business and its leaders.
    • Recruit, develop, and retain top People talent.
    • Continuously improve People processes, shared services, and technology solutions to create efficiency and enable more effective support for current business needs.
  • Lead Talent Acquisition Strategy and Scalable Recruiting Systems
    • Lead an enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy that positions the firm to attract and retain best-in-class talent and achieve sustainable, balanced, value-accretive growth goals.
    • Partner with senior business leaders to understand organizational goals and hiring priorities, strengthen external pipelines, elevate employment brand, and ensure recruiting resources are aligned to the roles and capabilities most critical to future growth.
    • Assess the recruiting operating model, systems, processes, data, sourcing channels, and team capabilities needed to deliver high-quality hires with speed, consistency, and strong candidate experience.
    • Continuously improve recruiting effectiveness through clear metrics, disciplined execution, market intelligence, and scalable practices that allow the firm to compete for top talent in a highly competitive market.
  • Champion High Performance Culture
    • Drive the organization's evolution toward a high-performance mindset where performance is managed consistently, talent is calibrated against clear standards, merit-based compensation is transparent and earned, and difficult performance conversations happen promptly and constructively.
    • Embed performance management, goal setting, and feedback as organizational norms — not just annual events.
  • Lead Compensation Strategy and Pay Equity
    • Partner with the Executive Compensation Committee to continuously evolve the firm’s base pay, incentives, and total compensation practices so they remain competitive with external market demands, internally equitable, and strategically aligned to business goals.
    • Ensure compensation practices reflect the firm’s philosophy of paying people fairly and treating them superbly through clear standards, accountability, transparency, and market-informed decision-making.
    • Strengthen communication and leader capability around compensation so team members understand how pay decisions are made and have confidence in the fairness, consistency, and intent behind those decisions.
  • Partner with Senior Leadership and Enterprise Stakeholders
    • Build deep partnerships with the Design Group executive team, business unit leaders, and divisional stakeholders.
    • Serve as a strategic advisor on organizational issues, talent gaps, and culture dynamics.
    • Maintain collaborative relationships with the Barry-Wehmiller People Team and People leaders in other BW platforms, contributing to broader talent initiatives and maintaining alignment with corporate strategy.
  • Lead Culture, Engagement, and Team Member Experience
    • Steward the firm's culture through regular engagement measurement and response, recognition programs, and firm-wide communications.
    • Ensure external talent integrates fully into the culture and feels welcomed into the organization.
    • Create structured experiences that set new team members up for success and build cultural integration.
    • Use team member feedback to identify cultural strengths to protect and gaps to address.
  • Define and Build People Analytics Strategy
    • Assess people-related data, systems, and KPIs and define holistic strategy for routine monitoring and reporting on recruiting pipeline, turnover/attrition, performance, and utilization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field required; Master's degree (MBA, HR, Organizational Development, or related) preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive human resources and talent leadership experience; C-suite People leadership experience (CHRO, VP People, Chief Talent Officer) strongly preferred.
  • At least 5 years in a senior or executive People role, ideally within engineering/architecture or other relevant professional services industries.
  • Experience in architecture/engineering, professional services, management consulting, or another complex, project-based business environment where talent quality, client service, and scalable growth are critical to success.

Knowledge/Skills Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide talent strategy for organizations of 1,000+ employees in multi-location, decentralized settings with aggressive growth targets.
  • Proven ability to build and lead high-performing HR functions spanning talent acquisition, HR business partnerships, compensation, talent development, and people operations.
  • Strong track record in enterprise talent acquisition, including executive recruitment, early-talent/leadership development programs, and pipeline building at scale.
  • Deep expertise in strategic workforce planning, organizational design, and role architecture — the ability to connect business strategy to organizational structure and staffing decisions.
  • Experience driving high-performance management culture through performance systems, talent calibration, pay-for-performance frameworks, and accountability.
  • Strong business acumen — ability to read P&Ls, understand market dynamics and competitive positioning, and translate business strategy into People priorities.
  • Excellent communicator who can influence across levels and functions without direct authority in a matrixed organization; skilled at building alignment among diverse stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with HRIS platforms and data analytics — ability to use data to drive decision-making and improve People processes; experience with HR technology implementation.
  • Skilled in change management and organizational transformation — guiding leaders and teams through significant structural or cultural shifts.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the resilience and political savvy to navigate complex, partnership-driven cultures; able to balance urgent operational needs with strategic long-term initiatives.

Location/Travel

  • This is an on-site position based out of our St. Louis, MO Head Office. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate.
  • Requires travel up to 25–30% to regional offices, client sites, and enterprise locations.

#LI-KF1




At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. Modernization isn’t just about new tools, it’s about understanding how an organization works and making it work better. Many teams know where they want to go but getting there efficiently, securely, and at mission speed takes an embedded specialist. That’s what you do, you move entire organizations forward through process automation and the development, integration, and improvement of artificial intelligence (AI) tools.


This is your opportunity to accelerate how the Department of War (DoW) understands its missions, capabilities, challenges, and modernization pathways. As a digital transformation specialist, you’ll work to enhance existing analytic processes via automation and AI integration that accelerates and improves the robustness of outputs and drives teamwide efficiency gains. Work with us as we lead change across force development, capability design, and strategic integration by building the processes, analyses, and tools that help the DoW evolve for the future.


What You'll Work On:

  • Automated location, ingestion, and targeted substantive analysis of unclassified and classified doctrine, policies, plans, strategic guidance, reports, surveys, and interview transcripts.

title: Mechanical Assembler
description:
Mechanical Assembler

Position Summary

OPEX Corporation is seeking a full-time Mechanical Assembler to join our manufacturing team at our World Headquarters in Moorestown, NJ.

This position is responsible for assembling and building industry-leading mail automation equipment using assembly drawings, hand tools, and power tools. We are looking for dependable, mechanically inclined individuals who take pride in producing quality work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Due to business needs and production demands, overtime and weekend work may be required.

If you are reliable, detail-oriented, mechanically skilled, and enjoy working as part of a team, OPEX may be the right place for you to grow your career.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Read and interpret assembly drawings, blueprints, and work instructions.
  • Assemble and build mail automation equipment according to engineering specifications.
  • Use a variety of hand tools and power tools safely and effectively.
  • Identify and install mechanical components including bearings, pulleys, springs, gears, and related hardware.
  • Perform quality checks to ensure assemblies meet required specifications and standards.
  • Follow established safety policies, procedures, and manufacturing practices.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.
  • Work independently and collaboratively with team members to meet production goals.
  • Support additional production and assembly activities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in mechanical assembly, manufacturing, production, automotive repair, construction, military maintenance, or a related hands-on field.
  • Experience using hand tools and power tools.
  • Experience reading assembly drawings, blueprints, or schematics.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot minor mechanical assembly issues.
  • Technical school, vocational training, or related mechanical training.
  • Mechanical aptitude and ability to work with mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Ability to read and interpret assembly drawings, blueprints, or mechanical instructions.
  • Ability to recognize common machine components, including pulleys, bearings, springs, and gears.
  • Ability to identify and work with hardware such as screws, bolts, nuts, washers, and snap rings.
  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work overtime and weekends as required.
  • Successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Work is performed in a manufacturing and warehouse environment.
  • Ability to maneuver throughout the work area, including confined spaces around equipment.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, squat, reach, and perform repetitive motions throughout the workday.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods as required.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to reach overhead and forward while assembling equipment.
  • Ability to safely use hand tools and power tools.

Hourly rate $17-20, based on experience.

title: Power Platform Engineer
description:
Public Consulting Group LLC (PCG) is a leading public sector solutions implementation and operations improvement firm that partners with health, education, and human services agencies to improve lives. Founded in 1986, PCG employs approximately 2,000 professionals throughout the U.S.—all committed to delivering solutions that change lives for the better. The firm is a member of a family of companies with experience in all 50 states, and clients in three Canadian provinces and Europe. PCG offers clients a multidisciplinary approach to meet challenges, pursue opportunities, and serve constituents across the public sector. To learn more, visit .

Collaborating with our Technology Consulting team, you will help organizations streamline operations and achieve strategic goals to serve the public better. We provide the full spectrum of technology consulting services to help state and local agencies meet operational and program needs that enhance the lives of their user base.

Services:

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy robust custom solutions leveraging Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse, to effectively meet business requirements.
  • Develop, customize, and maintain SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, and automated workflows, enhancing collaboration, efficiency, and document management capabilities.
  • Integrate Power Platform solutions seamlessly with Office 365 applications (Outlook, Teams) and other low-code/no-code platforms, streamlining business processes and facilitating efficient communication.
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, including business analysts, developers, and end-users, to gather, interpret, and document requirements, ensuring technical solutions align with strategic business goals.
  • Proactively identify and implement workflow and business process automation opportunities, significantly improving operational productivity and accuracy.
  • Provide comprehensive ongoing support, troubleshooting, and maintenance for existing Power Platform and SharePoint applications, ensuring continuous solution reliability and performance.
  • Create thorough documentation, including development procedures, system configurations, user guides, and training materials, to ensure successful adoption and long-term maintainability of solutions.
  • Liaise effectively with IT teams on application governance, data management, security protocols, user permissions, and compliance requirements, addressing privacy and risk management concerns proactively.
  • Actively participate in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, technical specification creation, solution design, development, rigorous testing, deployment, and post-production support.
  • Conduct detailed application testing, ensuring high-quality standards and performance criteria are consistently met.
  • Stay abreast of evolving Microsoft Power Platform and Office 365 features, best practices, and industry trends, continuously enhancing technical knowledge and solution innovation.

Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform tools including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse.
  • Strong experience developing and customizing SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, and automated workflows.
  • Familiarity with Office 365 suite integration (Outlook, Teams) and other low-code/no-code platforms.

  • Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, well-tested solutions.
  • Continuous learning mindset to stay updated with the latest developments in the Power Platform and Office 365 ecosystem.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.​

Experience

At least 2 years of experience in developing solutions using Microsoft Power Platform.​ Experience in automating workflows and business processes.

Certification

Microsoft Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200) or Developer (PL-400) certification is preferred.

This position is hybrid with travel/onsite requirements. To be successful at PCG, you must:
